notes.title: WHAT IS A LICENSE?｜何謂許可 / 特許權（License）？
notes.titleZh: 何謂許可 / 特許權（License）？

points.en: A personal privilege to enter and use the land of another for a specific purpose.
points.zh: 進入並使用他人土地的個人特權。

notes.body:
Definition｜定義
Key Legal Characteristics｜法律核心特徵（常考重點）
Not a True Interest in Land（非土地實質權益）: It does not create an estate or ownership interest.
Revocable（可隨時撤銷）: Can be taken away/canceled by the landowner at any time.
Does Not Transfer With Title（不隨產權移轉）: It is strictly personal to the holder and does not run with the land.
Creation（成立方式）: Can be created simply through an oral/spoken agreement.
Examples（實例）:
A ticket to a movie theater or sporting event.
Parking a car in a commercial parking garage.
Spoken permission to fish in a neighbor’s lake.
Etymology of Real Estate License｜房地產執照詞源意涵
Real: Refers to real property / immovable property.（指不動產／不可移動之物）
Estate: Refers to the duration of ownership or extent of interest.（指所有權限或持有的時間長短）

notes.title: THE -OR AND -EE RULE｜字尾「-OR」與「-EE」法則
notes.titleZh: 字尾「-OR」與「-EE」法則
notes.body:
在不動產法律術語中，行為發起者與接受者的字尾規則是核心考點：
General Rule｜通用規則
-OR = The Giver / Actor（給予者／行為發起人）
-EE = The Receiver（接受者／受領人）
Grantor（讓與人 / 出讓人）：The party who gives/conveys property or title.（轉讓／出讓產權之人）
Grantee（受讓人 / 買受人）：The party who receives property or title.（接受產權讓與之人）
Lessor（出租人 / 房東）：The party giving the lease (landlord).（給予租約、出租房屋者）
Lessee（承租人 / 房客）：The party receiving the lease (tenant).（接受租約、承租房屋者）
Vendor（賣方，特別常見於土地契約）：The seller who sells property.（出售房地產之賣方）
Vendee（買方，特別常見於土地契約）：The buyer who purchases/acquires property.（購買房地產之買方）
Optionor（選擇權授與人）：The owner giving the option to buy.（給予購買選擇權之屋主）
Optionee（選擇權受領人）：The party receiving the right/option to buy.（取得購買選擇權之人）
Trustor（信託委託人 / 借款人）：The borrower who pledges/conveys legal title to a trustee in a trust deed.（將產權信託給受託人的借款方）
Trustee（受託人 / 第三方機構）：The neutral third party receiving legal title to hold in trust.（持有產權的公正第三方，如產權保險公司）
Mortgagor（抵押人 / 借款人 / 買方）：The borrower who gives the mortgage/pledge of property as security.（以房產作為抵押擔保借款之買方）
Mortgagee（抵押權人 / 貸款機構 / 銀行）：The lender who receives the mortgage/pledge of property.（接受房屋抵押擔保並提供資金之銀行/放貸機構）
Offeror（要約人）：The party who makes/gives an offer.（提出買賣要約者，通常為買方）
Offeree（受要約人）：The party who receives the offer.（接收要約者，通常為賣方）

notes.title: Mortgagor vs. Mortgagee 易混淆考點解析
notes.titleEn: Mortgagor vs. Mortgagee 易混淆考點解析

points.en: Borrowers often mistakenly think they are receiving money, so they should end in "-ee". However, legally, the borrower is giving/pledging the property as collateral to secure the debt → Mortgagor. The lender receives the pledge → Mortgagee.
points.zh: 考生常誤以為借款人「拿錢」應為 -ee；但法律上抵押權的標的是「擔保物」，借款人是提供（Pledging）房產作為抵押的一方，故為 Mortgagor；銀行/貸方是接受抵押擔保的一方，故為 Mortgagee。

notes.title: PROPERTY OWNERSHIP｜不動產所有權（概述）
notes.titleZh: 不動產所有權（概述）

points.en: Property ownership is not just physical land, but a "bundle of rights" (legal interests and privileges) attached to ownership.
points.zh: 房地產所有權並非僅指土地實體，而是一整套附隨於產權的「權利束（各項合法權益與特權）」。

notes.body: Bundle of Rights Concept｜權利束概念

notes.title: 1. Bundle of Rights（權利束）
notes.titleZh: 權利束

points.en: The rights and legal interests that accompany real property ownership, including the right to use, give away, sell, mortgage, lease, rent, enter, or refuse to exercise any of these rights.
points.zh: 隨不動產所有權附帶的一整套法律權利與權益，包括使用、贈與、出售、抵押、出租、進入以及拒絕行使上述任何權利的自由。

notes.sentenceEn: Real property ownership is legally conceptualized as a bundle of rights, meaning that while the fee simple owner possesses the comprehensive authority to possess, use, transfer, encumber, and exclude others, such rights remain perpetually subject to governmental powers and voluntary or involuntary encumbrances, such as mechanic's liens, which temporarily suspend the unfettered exercise of specific stick privileges within that bundle until legally satisfied.
notes.grammar:
1. Main Clause（主句結構）
• Subject + Verb + Predicate: "Real property ownership (主詞) is legally conceptualized (動詞) as a bundle of rights (補語)..."
• 中文解析: 「不動產所有權在法律上被概念化為一包/一束權利...」使用被動語態表示法律上的定義與共識。
2. Participle Clause & Concession Clause（分詞片語與對比從句）
• Present Participle ("meaning that..."): 引導補充說明，解釋「bundle of rights」的具體法律涵義。
• Adversative Clause ("while..."): "while the fee simple owner possesses the comprehensive authority to possess, use, transfer, encumber, and exclude others..." 表示「儘管完全所有權人擁有占有、使用、轉讓、設定負擔與排除他人干涉之完整權限...」。後接一系列動詞原形不定詞作為補語。
3. Core Legal Restrictions & Relative Clause（核心限制與關係從句）
• Principal Predicate in "that" clause: "...such rights remain perpetually subject to governmental powers and... encumbrances..."（此類權利仍永久受制於政府公權力及負擔限制）。
• Non-restrictive Relative Clause ("which..."): "...which temporarily suspend the unfettered exercise of specific stick privileges within that bundle until legally satisfied." 關係代名詞 which 修飾前面的 encumbrances（如技工留置權 mechanic's liens），說明其法律效果為「暫時凍結/懸置權利束中特定細項特權的自由行使，直至依法獲得清償/滿足」。
notes.examFocus: 重點考向：產權並非絕對不受干涉，它受他人權利限制（如留置權會暫時限制權利束中某些權利的行使，直到清償解除）。 (解析重點：掌握 bundle of rights、encumber、unfettered exercise、legally satisfied 等法律詞彙之搭配。)

notes.title: 2. Real Property vs. Personal Property（不動產 vs. 動產）
notes.titleZh: 不動產 vs. 動產

points.en: Real property encompasses all things permanently attached to the land and inherent bundle of rights (General rule: Real = Immovable). Personal property (also termed "Chattels" or "Personalty") refers to movable items (e.g., furniture, art, clothing).
points.zh: 不動產包含土地、永久附著於土地之物及固有的各項權益（核心通則：不動產＝不可移動）。動產（考試又稱 Chattels 或 Personalty）則指通常可移動之物品（如家具、藝術品、衣物等）。

notes.sentenceEn: While real property encompasses not only the physical surface of the earth and everything permanently annexed to it but also the intangible interests inherent in the land, personal property, often designated as chattels or personalty in legal instruments, consists of movable items that typically follow the person rather than the real estate upon the transfer of title.
notes.grammar:
1. Concession & Contrast Clause（讓步與對比從句）
• Adversative Conjunction ("While..."): 引導讓步複句，表示「儘管不動產不僅包含...而且還包含...」。用於將「不動產 (Real property)」與主句的「動產 (Personal property)」進行對照。
• Not only... but also...（不僅...而且...）: 連接平行結構 "the physical surface..." 與 "the intangible interests..."，說明不動產涵蓋實體土地與無形權益。
2. Main Clause & Participle Modifier（主句與分詞修飾語）
• Main Subject + Verb: "...personal property... consists of movable items..."（主詞為動產，動詞為由...組成）。
• Past Participle Phrase ("designated as..."): 過去分詞片語作為後位修飾語，修飾前面的 personal property，說明其在法律文件中常被稱為 chattels 或 personalty。
3. Relative Clause & Prepositional Contrast（關係從句與介系詞對比）
• Relative Clause ("that typically follow..."): 關係代名詞 that 引導限定修飾語修飾 items，說明動產具備可移動性。
• Prepositional Phrase ("follow the person rather than the real estate"): 使用 "rather than"（而非）對比「跟隨人移動」與「附著於不動產」，強調產權移轉時動產的歸屬特性。
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：留意 annexed to、intangible interests、designated as chattels 等常用題幹修飾語。)

notes.title: 3. Severance vs. Annexation（分離轉換 vs. 附著轉換）
notes.titleZh: 分離轉換 vs. 附著轉換

points.en: Severance is the act of converting real property to personal property by detaching it from the land (e.g., felling a growing tree). Annexation is attaching personal property to real property, effectively converting it into a fixture (e.g., installing plumbing pipes and sinks).
points.zh: 「分離（Severance）」是將物品自土地脫離，使其由不動產轉變為動產（例如砍倒生長中的樹木）。「附著（Annexation）」則是將動產固定於不動產上，使其成為定著物（例如將水槽與水管接通安裝）。

notes.sentenceEn: The legal characterization of an item can be altered through severance, whereby a growing tree classified as real property becomes personal property the moment it is severed from the soil, or conversely through annexation, where personal materials are affixed to an existing structure in a manner that integrates them permanently into the real estate.
notes.grammar:
1. Main Clause（主句結構）
• Subject + Passive Voice Verb: "The legal characterization of an item (主詞) can be altered (被動語態動詞) through severance..."
• 中文解析: 「物品的法律性質可透過分離（severance）而被改變...」主句使用被動語態 can be altered 表示客觀法律效果的產生。
2. Relative Clause & Time Clause（關係從句與時間從句）
• Adverbial Relative Adverb ("whereby..."): 引導副詞性關係從句，解釋透過 severance 如何實現轉變："whereby a growing tree classified as real property becomes personal property..."（藉此，原本歸類為不動產的生長中樹木轉變為動產）。其中 classified as real property 為過去分詞片語後位修飾 a growing tree。
• Time Clause ("the moment..."): 表示「在一...的瞬間/時刻」："the moment it is severed from the soil"（在一從土壤中被鋸斷/分離的瞬間）。

notes.title: 3. Contrast & Parallel Relative Clause（對比與平行關係從句）
notes.titleZh: 對比與平行關係從句
notes.body:
• Adversative Transition ("or conversely through annexation..."): 使用 conversely（相反地）對比「分離（severance）」與「附著（annexation）」。
• Relative Adverb ("where..."): 引導關係從句修飾 annexation: "where personal materials are affixed to an existing structure..."（在此情況下，動產材料被附著於現有結構物上）。
• Relative Clause ("in a manner that..."): 引導限定關係從句修飾 manner: "in a manner that integrates them permanently into the real estate"（以一種將其永久整合至不動產中的方式）。
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 whereby、severed from the soil、conversely through annexation 等轉折與定語從句。)

notes.title: 4. Fixtures & The MARIA Test（定著物及其判定標準）
notes.titleZh: 定著物及其判定標準

points.en: A fixture is personal property that has been attached to the real estate in such a manner that it becomes part of the real property.
points.zh: 定著物是指原本為動產，但因固定或安裝於不動產上而轉化為不動產一部分的物品（如水晶吊燈、馬桶）。

notes.body:
判定五大原則（Acronym: MARIA）：
M - Method of attachment: How permanently is it affixed (screws, nails, cement, wires)?（附著方式是否牢固）
A - Adaptability: Is the item custom-fit or integral to the specific realty (e.g., custom pool cover)?（適應性/專用性）
R - Relationship of the parties: In disputes, courts favor buyers over sellers, and tenants over landlords.（當事人關係傾向保護買方或租客）
I - Intention of the annexor: Was it installed with the intent of making a permanent accession?（附著時的客觀意圖）
A - Agreement between the parties: The express terms in the written purchase contract supersede all other tests.（雙方合約書面約定最優先）
notes.sentenceEn: When determining whether a contested article of personal property has converted into a fixture that automatically conveys with the real property, courts rely on the five legal tests summarized by the acronym MARIA, with the express written agreement of the contracting parties holding absolute supremacy over the physical method of attachment or adaptability of the item.
notes.grammar:
1. Temporal Adverbial Clause（時間副詞從句）
• Subordinate Conjunction ("When..."): 引導時間副詞從句 "When determining whether a contested article of personal property has converted into a fixture..."，表示「在判定爭議動產是否已轉化為定著物時...」。
2. Main Clause & Object Clause（主句與賓語從句）
• Main Subject + Verb: "courts (主詞) rely on (動詞) the five legal tests..."，表示「法院依賴五項法律測試...」。
• Noun Clause ("whether..."): 作為 determining 的賓語，說明判定之具體事項。
3. Participle Modifier & Prepositional Phrase（分詞片語與優先順序）
• Present Participle Phrase ("with... holding..."): 引導獨立分詞結構，強調雙方書面合約（written agreement）具有最高優先效力（absolute supremacy）。
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 contested article、conveys with、holding absolute supremacy over 等高頻考試措辭。)

notes.title: 5. Trade Fixtures（營業用定著物 / 商業設備）
notes.titleZh: 營業用定著物 / 商業設備

points.en: Articles of personal property installed by a commercial tenant for the purpose of conducting a trade or business (e.g., dentist chairs, retail display cases). They remain the personal property of the tenant and may be removed prior to the expiration of the lease, provided the tenant repairs or compensates for any physical damage caused by removal.
points.zh: 商業租戶為經營生意而安裝於租賃物上的設備（如牙醫治療椅、展示櫃）。法律上仍屬於承租人的動產，承租人可在租期結束前拆除帶走，但必須修復因拆除造成的損壞或予以賠償。

notes.sentenceEn: Notwithstanding the fact that commercial equipment might be securely fastened to the floors or walls of a leased building, trade fixtures installed by a commercial tenant for business purposes retain their classification as personal property and may be detached prior to the termination of the lease, provided that the tenant restores the premises to its original condition.
notes.grammar:
1. Concession Clause（讓步狀語從句）
• Conjunction ("Notwithstanding the fact that..."): 引導讓步從句，表示「儘管/雖然...」，後面接完整子句 "commercial equipment might be securely fastened to the floors or walls of a leased building"，指出設備可能已固定於建築物上的客觀事實。
2. Main Clause（主句結構）
• Subject: "trade fixtures installed by a commercial tenant for business purposes"（主詞：商業租戶為營業目的安裝之營業用定著物；其中 installed by... 為過去分詞片語後位修飾主詞）。
• Compound Predicate Verbs: 第 compound 動詞為 "retain their classification as personal property"（保持其動產之分類）；第二 compound 動詞為 "may be detached prior to the termination of the lease"（得於租期終止前拆除）。
3. Conditional Clause（條件狀語從句）
• Conjunction ("provided that..."): 引導條件從句，表示「前提是... / 只要...」，後接 "the tenant restores the premises to its original condition"（租客將房屋恢復原狀），說明拆除權利成立之法律前提條件。
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：句首 Notwithstanding the fact that（儘管...）是考題常用來混淆 trade fixture 與普通 fixture 的經典結構。)

notes.title: 6. Appurtenance（從屬物 / 從屬權利）
notes.titleZh: 從屬物 / 從屬權利

points.en: A right, privilege, or physical improvement that belongs to and passes with the ownership of the land (e.g., barns, houses, or appurtenant easements). It is inherently incidental and subordinate to the principal property.
points.zh: 附屬於主體土地並隨產權一併移轉（Runs with the land）的權利、特權或地上建築物（如穀倉、地役權等），其地位從屬於主物。

notes.sentenceEn: An appurtenance is legally defined as an incidental right, privilege, or physical improvement that is attached to and passes with the principal property upon conveyance, meaning that it automatically transfers to the grantee even if not explicitly referenced within the four corners of the deed.
notes.grammar:
1. Main Clause（主句結構）
• Subject + Passive Voice Verb: "An appurtenance (主詞) is legally defined (被動語態動詞) as an incidental right, privilege, or physical improvement (補語)..."
• 中文解析: 主句採用被動語態 "is defined as"，定義「從屬物/權利（appurtenance）」之法律概念為「附隨的權利、特權或實體改良物」。
2. Relative Clause（限定關係從句）
• Relative Pronoun ("that is attached to and passes with..."): 引導限定關係從句，修飾前面的 "right, privilege, or physical improvement"。
• Parallel Verbs: 連接兩個平行動詞片語 "is attached to"（附著於）與 "passes with"（隨...一併移轉），說明該權利與主體不動產（principal property）在過戶（conveyance）時緊密相連。
3. Participle Clause & Concession Clause（分詞片語與讓步從句）
• Present Participle ("meaning that..."): 引導現在分詞片語作為補充說明，解釋該法律特性的實質效果。
• Concession Clause ("even if not explicitly referenced..."): 使用 "even if" 引導簡化讓步從句，說明「即使未在契據全文條款（four corners of the deed）中明確載明」，該權利仍會自動移轉給受讓人（grantee）。
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：留意 incidental right、passes with the principal property、four corners of the deed（契約字面條款）之用法。)

notes.title: 7. Encroachment（越界侵占）
notes.titleZh: 越界侵占

points.en: The unauthorized, physical intrusion of a building, structure, or improvement (such as a fence, driveway, or overhanging tree branches) onto the land or airspace of an adjoining owner. Typically discovered by an official land survey and constitutes a form of legal trespass.
points.zh: 建築物、改良物或附屬物（如圍籬、車道、懸垂樹枝）未經授權實體侵入相鄰土地或上空的行為。通常需經由土地測量（Survey）確認，在法律上構成侵入住居/非法侵占（Trespass）。

notes.sentenceEn: An encroachment, which occurs when an improvement such as a fence or roof overhang unlawfully extends across an adjacent property boundary, is treated under common law as a continuous trespass that may be revealed by a professional survey and resolved through injunctive relief or monetary damages.
notes.grammar:
1. Main Clause（主句結構）
• Subject + Verb + Predicate: "An encroachment (主詞)... is treated (被動態動詞) under common law as a continuous trespass (補語)..."
• 中文解析: 「越界侵占在普通法下被視為一種持續性侵權行為...」主句採用被動語態 is treated as 表示法律上的歸類與認定。
2. Non-restrictive Relative Clause & Time Clause（非限定關係從句與時間從句）
• Non-restrictive Relative Clause ("which occurs..."): 插入語非限定關係從句修飾主詞 An encroachment，說明其產生的定義與條件。
• Time Clause ("when an improvement... unlawfully extends..."): 由 when 引導的時間狀語從句，說明具體侵權動作為地上改良物（如圍籬或屋簷）非法跨越相鄰產權地界。
3. Relative Clause & Parallel Structure（限定關係從句與平行結構）
• Relative Clause ("that may be revealed... and resolved..."): 限定關係從句修飾 continuous trespass。
• Parallel Passive Verbs: 連接兩種救濟與認定機制——may be revealed by a professional survey（可經由專業土地測量發現）與 resolved through injunctive relief or monetary damages（並可透過法院禁制令救濟或金錢賠償解決）。
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 continuous trespass、revealed by a professional survey、injunctive relief（禁制令救濟）等用語。)

notes.title: 8. Emblements（農作物收益權 / 收益動產）
notes.titleZh: 農作物收益權 / 收益動產

points.en: Annual, cultivated industrial crops (fructus industriales) produced by the labor of a tenant farmer. Classified as personal property. Under the doctrine of emblements, a tenant farmer maintains the right to re-enter the land to cultivate and harvest that season's crops even after the sudden termination of their estate through no fault of their own.
points.zh: 租戶農民透過人工辛勤耕作的年度農作物。被視為動產（Personal Property）。依據農作物收益權法則，即使租約期滿或非因租客過錯而終止，農民仍保有於該生長季結束前返回土地採收其勞動成果的權利。

notes.sentenceEn: Under the doctrine of emblements, annually cultivated agricultural crops resulting from a tenant farmer's labor are classified as personal property, thereby granting the farmer an implied legal right to cultivate and harvest those crops even after the tenancy has unexpectedly terminated prior to the completion of the growing season.
notes.grammar:
1. Prepositional Phrase & Main Clause（介系詞片語與主句結構）
• Prepositional Phrase ("Under the doctrine..."): 句首介系詞片語說明法律依據（依據農作物收益權法則）。
• Main Subject + Passive Voice: "annually cultivated agricultural crops (主詞) ... are classified as personal property (被動語態動詞與補語)"，表示「年度耕作之農作物被歸類為動產」。其中 resulting from a tenant farmer's labor 為分詞片語後位修飾 crops。
2. Participle Clause & Concession/Time Clause（分詞片語與時間從句）
• Present Participle ("thereby granting..."): 現在分詞片語引導結果說明，表示「從而賦予農民耕作與採收之默示法律權利」。
• Time Clause ("even after..."): 由 "even after" 引導副詞從句，說明「即使租款在生長季結束前意外終止」，該權利依然成立。
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 annually cultivated、implied legal right、unexpectedly terminated 等組合。)

notes.title: 9. Water Rights & Water Alteration Terms（水權及水體物理變動）
notes.titleZh: 水權及水體物理變動
notes.body:
Riparian Rights: Rights granted to landowners along flowing bodies of water, such as rivers and streams (Riparian = River).
Littoral Rights: Rights granted to owners bordering non-flowing navigable bodies of water, such as oceans, seas, and lakes (Littoral = Lake).
Correlative Use: The legal right of a landowner to draw underground percolating water or river water for irrigation purposes on a reasonable basis.
Doctrine of Prior Appropriation: A regulatory scheme in arid regions where water rights are not determined by land adjacency, but allocated by state permits based on the chronological priority of beneficial use.
Accretion: Gradual accumulation of soil via water action that expands land boundaries.
Reliction: Gradual receding of water that exposes newly dry, usable land.
Erosion: Gradual wearing away of land due to wind, water currents, or tidal action.
Avulsion: Sudden, violent tearing away or displacement of land by rapid natural occurrences (e.g., dam failures, flash floods, earthquakes).
notes.sentenceEn: In jurisdictions governed by traditional common law water doctrines, riparian owners along flowing streams hold reasonable use rights that differ distinctly from littoral owners along stationary lakes, while in arid western states, the doctrine of prior appropriation supersedes these riparian privileges by granting superior water rights based strictly on the historical date of beneficial use rather than geographic adjacency.
notes.grammar:
1. Main Clause（主句結構）
• Subject + Verb + Object: "riparian owners (主詞) ... hold (動詞) reasonable use rights (賓語)..."
• 中文解析: 「沿岸土地所有權人擁有合理使用水資源的權利」。主句明確指出沿岸業主所擁有的核心法律權利。
2. Contrast Clause with 'while'（使用 'while' 的對比從句）
• Adversative Conjunction ("while..."): 用來引導與主句形成對比的法律規則："while in arid western states, the doctrine of prior appropriation supersedes these riparian privileges..."（然而在乾燥的西部各州，優先佔有原則取代了這些沿岸權利）。
3. Prepositional Modifiers（介系詞修飾語）
• Introductory Prepositional Phrase: "In jurisdictions governed by traditional common law water doctrines..."（在受傳統普通法水權法則管轄的管轄區內），修飾整個句子，說明適用之法律背景。
• Prepositional Phrases for Basis & Contrast: "based strictly on the historical date..."（嚴格依據歷史使用日期）與 "rather than geographic adjacency"（而非地理上的相鄰關係），分別用來修飾水權的分配依據與排他條件。
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：區分 reasonable use rights、prior appropriation、geographic adjacency 等常見比較題用語。)

notes.title: 1. Freehold Estates Overview（自由繼承產權概述）
notes.titleZh: 自由繼承產權概述

points.en: An ownership estate in real property characterized by exclusive possession for an indefinite or unpredictable duration.
points.zh: 具有排他佔有使用權，且其存續期間為無限期或不可預測（無固定終止日）的不動產所有權權益。

notes.title: 2. Fee Simple Absolute（完全所有權 / 絕對無條件繼承地產）
notes.titleZh: 完全所有權 / 絕對無條件繼承地產

points.en: The highest, most complete, and unrestricted ownership interest recognized in real property. It carries the full bundle of rights, is completely inheritable by heirs without reverting to the prior grantor, and is subject only to government powers (Police power, Eminent domain, Taxation, Escheat - PETE) and private encumbrances.
points.zh: 法律所承認最高級、最完整且無附加限制的產權。可自由由繼承人繼承，絕不因任何特定條件而自動回歸讓與人，僅受政府四大權力（PETE）及約定之物權負擔限制。

notes.sentenceEn: A fee simple absolute represents the maximum possible estate a person can hold in real property, granting the holder perpetual ownership and unlimited rights of disposition that cannot be defeated by previous owners or their heirs, subject solely to public limitations like taxation and private encumbrances such as recorded liens.
notes.grammar:
1. Main Clause（主句結構）
• Subject + Verb + Predicate: "A fee simple absolute (主詞) represents (動詞) the maximum possible estate (賓語)..."
• 中文解析: 主句說明「完全所有權代表了一個人在不動產中所能持有的最大可能地產」。
2. Participle Modifier & Relative Clause（分詞修飾語與關係從句）
• Present Participle ("granting..."): 現在分詞片語作為補充說明，表示該產權賦予持有人永久所有權與無限處分權。
• Relative Clause ("that cannot be defeated..."): 關係代名詞 that 修飾前方的 rights of disposition，說明這些處分權利無法被前手所有權人或其繼承人推翻/廢除。
3. Prepositional Modifier ("subject solely to...")（限制條件修飾語）
• Adjective Phrase ("subject solely to..."): 修飾前面的所有權與處分權，表示此類權利「僅受制於」公共限制（如課稅）與私人負擔（如已登記的留置權）。
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 maximum possible estate、perpetual ownership、cannot be defeated by 等核心描述。)

notes.title: 3. Fee Simple Defeasible（可廢止 / 附條件繼承地產）
notes.titleZh: 可廢止 / 附條件繼承地產

points.en: A fee estate subject to specific conditions or limitations inserted by the grantor into the conveyance deed. If the stipulated condition is violated, the title may be defeated and forfeited.
points.zh: 讓與人在地契中附加特定條件或限制的所有權。一旦違反條款，產權可能被撤銷沒收。「限定決定產權」在條件發生時自動回歸讓與人；「解除條件產權」則需由讓與人主動採取法律行動重新進入並主張收回產權。

notes.body:
Fee Simple Determinable: Automatically terminates and reverts to the grantor/estate immediately upon the occurrence of a specified event (e.g., "so long as used as a public library").
Fee Simple Subject to a Condition Subsequent: Does not terminate automatically; the grantor must take affirmative legal action to re-enter and reclaim title upon violation (e.g., "provided no alcohol is sold").
notes.sentenceEn: A fee simple determinable automatically ends and reverts to the original grantor without requiring judicial intervention if the specific restrictive limitation (such as maintaining the land solely for educational purposes) is breached, whereas a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent mandates that the grantor affirmatively exercise a right of re-entry to extinguish the estate.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 automatically ends and reverts、judicial intervention、affirmatively exercise a right of re-entry 等考題辨析重點。)

notes.title: 4. Life Estate & Pur Autre Vie（終身地產 / 終身權）
notes.titleZh: 終身地產 / 終身權

points.en: A freehold estate limited in duration to the measuring life of the holder (life tenant) or another designated individual (pur autre vie).
points.zh: 存續期間以受領人或指定第三人之生命長度為準的產權。身故後產權歸還原讓與人者稱為「回復權（Reversion）」；轉移給第三人者稱為「剩餘權（Remainder）」。終身權人負有納稅與維持物業之義務，嚴禁造成損耗/毀損（Waste）。終身權人不得立遺囑處分該物業，其所簽訂的租約或抵押於其身故時全數終止。

notes.body:
Estate in Reversion: Title reverts back to the original grantor upon the death of the measuring life.
Estate in Remainder: Title passes forward to a specified third party (designated as the remainderman) upon the death of the measuring life.
Duties & Restrictions: The life tenant is obligated to pay ordinary property taxes and maintain the property; the life tenant is prohibited from committing waste (allowing severe physical decay or economic destruction). A life tenant cannot devise the property via a will, and any leases or mortgages executed by them terminate automatically upon their death.
notes.sentenceEn: Although a life tenant has the legitimate authority to mortgage, lease, or enjoy the physical fruits of the real property for the duration of the measuring life, they cannot devise the underlying fee simple title in a will, and they are strictly bound by fiduciary-like obligations not to commit waste that would diminish the value of the future interest held by the remainderman.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 measuring life、devise the underlying title、commit waste、remainderman 等專業術語。)

notes.title: 1. Four Types of Leasehold Estates（四類租賃權型態）
notes.titleZh: 四類租賃權型態

points.en: A leasehold interest for a definite, fixed period of time with predetermined commencement and termination dates (e.g., 6 months, 5 years). No notice is required to terminate at the end date.
points.zh: 具有確定開始與結束日期的定期租賃（例如 6 個月短租或 5 年商業約）。租期屆滿自動終止，無須發出終止通知。

points.en: An ongoing tenancy that automatically renews for successive equal intervals of time (e.g., month-to-month, week-to-week) unless proper statutory advance notice is provided by either party.
points.zh: 無固定結束日期，按週、月或年自動連續遞延續約的租賃。欲終止合約，任一方皆必須依法提前給予法定解約通知。

points.en: Arises when a tenant who originally entered into possession lawfully retains possession without the landlord's consent after the expiration of the lease (a holdover tenant). It differs from initial trespass because the original entry was lawful, but the landlord must pursue legal eviction rather than self-help remedies.
points.zh: 租約到期後，原合法承租人未經房東同意賴著不走且拒繳租金（超期滯留租客 Holdover tenant）。因最初具合法進駐權，故非單純擅闖，但房東必須透過法定訴訟程序進行驅逐。

points.en: A tenancy of indefinite duration that permits possession by the tenant for an unspecified time and may be terminated by either party at any time. (Largely prohibited or tightly regulated by statute in many jurisdictions).
points.zh: 存續期不固定，任一方均可隨時終止的租賃權（在許多州的現行法規中已被禁止或受極大限制）。

notes.body:
Estate for Years / Tenancy for Years（定期租賃權）：
Periodic Tenancy / Estate from Period to Period（週期性租賃權）：
Estate at Sufferance / Tenancy at Sufferance（容忍租賃 / 轉非法人住租賃）：
Estate at Will（隨意租賃 / 不定期租賃）：
notes.sentenceEn: The fundamental legal distinction between an estate for years and a periodic tenancy lies in the termination mechanism: an estate for years automatically self-terminates upon the arrival of its predetermined calendar date without requiring any formal notice, whereas a periodic tenancy continually rolls over into consecutive periods until affirmative statutory notice is formally served by either lessor or lessee.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 self-terminates upon、consecutive periods、affirmative statutory notice is formally served 等對比句構。)

notes.title: 2. Leases, Covenants & Eviction Concepts（租約法律原則、約定條款與驅逐）
notes.titleZh: 租約法律原則、約定條款與驅逐
notes.body:
Reversionary Right: The lessor's retained legal right to retake exclusive possession of the property upon the expiration of the leasehold term.
Covenant of Quiet Enjoyment: The implied or express promise that the lessee shall have uninterrupted possession and peaceful use of the premises free from unlawful interference by the landlord or any person with superior legal title.
Assignment vs. Subletting: Assignment involves a complete transfer of all remaining leasehold rights and obligations to a new tenant (assignee), whereas subletting transfers only a portion of the term or space, keeping the original lessee (sublessor) primarily liable to the landlord.
Constructive Eviction: Occurs when a landlord breaches a legal duty or lease covenant by substantially failing to maintain the property in a habitable condition (e.g., terminating heat or basic water supply), thereby effectively compelling the tenant to vacate the premises and claim discharge from further rent obligations.
notes.sentenceEn: If a residential landlord deliberately neglects essential repairs to the extent that the premises become legally uninhabitable—such as by failing to furnish mandatory heating in winter—the tenant may declare a constructive eviction, surrender physical possession, and be completely relieved of future rental liabilities under the lease agreement.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 become legally uninhabitable、declare a constructive eviction、surrender physical possession、relieved of rental liabilities 等因果關聯詞。)

notes.title: 3. Property Management（物業管理原則）
notes.titleZh: 物業管理原則
notes.body:
Agency & Fiduciary Status: A property manager acts as a General Agent of the property owner, bound by comprehensive Fiduciary Duties of trust, loyalty, and care.
Primary Objectives: Maximize net operating income while concurrently preserving and enhancing the long-term physical and economic value of the asset.
Due Date Rule: If the written lease agreement is completely silent on a payment deadline, rent is legally due on the last day of the leasing period.
Four Risk Management Strategies:
Avoid: Eliminate the hazardous condition entirely (e.g., removing a dilapidated trampoline).
Deal / Retain: Absorb manageable losses directly by electing insurance policies with high deductibles.
Control: Mitigate loss severity through preventative safety mechanisms (e.g., installing automatic sprinkler systems and security cameras).
Transfer: Shift comprehensive liability to third-party insurance underwriters via policies with zero deductibles.
notes.sentenceEn: Operating as a general agent under a written management contract, a professional property manager owes broad fiduciary duties to the property owner, with the principal objective of maximizing the net operating income while implementing effective risk management strategies—such as transferring catastrophic exposure to insurance carriers and controlling localized risks through modern life-safety installations.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 broad fiduciary duties、net operating income、transferring catastrophic exposure、controlling localized risks 等商業物管專用詞彙。)

notes.title: 4. Commercial & Residential Types of Leases（租賃合約類型）
notes.titleZh: 租賃合約類型

points.en: The tenant pays a fixed, flat rental amount. The landlord pays all operating expenses, property taxes, structural repairs, and property insurance (standard in residential leases).
points.zh: 承租人每月支付固定租金；出租人（房東）負責支付所有的地產稅、保險、結構維修及日常營運開支（住宅市場最普遍）。

points.en: Rent is calculated partly or entirely as a percentage of the gross sales/receipts generated on the commercial premises. Typically seen in major shopping centers and retail outlets, allowing landlord and tenant to mutually share the economic benefits of high-traffic commercial locations.
points.zh: 租金金額直接按承租人在該營業場所產生的總營業額（Gross Sales）抽成計算。廣泛應用於大型購物中心與零售商場，使房東與租戶共同分享精華地段帶來的高營收。

points.en: The tenant pays a base rent plus some or all of the property's ongoing operating expenses, including property taxes, building insurance, and routine maintenance costs.
points.zh: 承租人除支付基本固定租金外，還需自行負擔物業的不動產稅、保險費以及維護營運費用（商業租賃常見之 Triple Net / NNN）。

points.en: A lease agreement containing a clause giving the tenant the legal option to purchase the leased real estate during or at the end of the term.
points.zh: 租約中包含一項條款，賦予租戶在租期內或期滿時擁有依約定條件購買該房產的優先選擇權。房東為授與人（Optionor），租戶為受領人（Optionee），且租戶必須給付法律對價（Consideration）以維持選擇權的合法效力。

notes.body:
Gross Lease（毛租約 / 總額租約）：
Percentage Lease（抽成租約 / 百分比租約）：
Net Lease / Triple Net Lease (NNN)（淨租約 / 三淨租賃）：
Lease Option（附買回選擇權租約）：
Key Parties: The landlord is the Optionor (obligated to sell if exercised), and the tenant is the Optionee (holds the choice to buy).
Consideration Requirement: The optionee must provide valuable consideration (either upfront non-refundable cash or designated rent premiums) to bind the optionor to the terms of the agreement.
—-----------------
notes.sentenceEn: Under a triple net (NNN) lease commonly utilized in commercial real estate, the tenant assumes the contractual obligation to pay a base rental amount in addition to real estate taxes, hazard insurance, and property maintenance, whereas in a percentage lease, commercial rent fluctuates dynamically based on a stipulated percentage of the business's gross receipts.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 assumes the contractual obligation to pay、fluctuates dynamically based on、stipulated percentage 等商業租賃題幹關鍵句式。)

notes.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
notes.title: 一、EASEMENTS（地役權總論與附屬地役權）
notes.titleZh: 地役權總論與附屬地役權

points.en: An easement is the right to use the land of another for a specific purpose (such as access or utilities). It "runs with the land," meaning it automatically transfers to the new owner upon conveyance, and must be in writing. Key concepts include "ingress" (the right to enter) and "egress" (the right to exit).
points.zh: 地役權指為特定目的（例如通行或公用設施）而使用他人土地的合法權利。地役權具「附隨於土地（Runs with the land）」之性質，產權移轉時自動轉給新所有人，且必須以書面為之。核心術語包括 Ingress（進入權）與 Egress（外出/離開權）。

points.en: An easement is the right to use the land of another for a specific purpose (such as access or utilities). It "runs with the land," meaning it automatically transfers to the new owner upon conveyance, and must be in writing. Key concepts include "ingress" (the right to enter) and "egress" (the right to exit).
points.zh: 附屬地役權牽涉相鄰之兩筆不同所有權土地。受惠並取得通行利益的土地稱為需役地（Dominant Tenement）；負擔並提供他人通行的土地稱為供役地（Servient Tenement）。

notes.body: Appurtenant Easement（從屬/附屬地役權）: Involves two separate parcels owned by two different parties. The Dominant Tenement is the parcel that benefits from the easement, while the Servient Tenement is the parcel burdened by the easement.
notes.sentenceEn: An appurtenant easement creates an incorporeal right attached to the dominant estate that burdens the adjacent servient estate, granting essential ingress and egress rights that legally run with the land and automatically convey to subsequent grantees, regardless of whether specifically referenced in the deed.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 dominant estate、servient estate、ingress and egress、runs with the land 等搭配。)

notes.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
notes.title: 二、EXPRESS EASEMENTS（明示地役權）
notes.titleZh: 明示地役權

points.en: An express easement is explicitly created in writing, typically through an express grant or an express reservation.
points.zh: 明示地役權是以書面明確訂立的地役權，主要透過「明示授與」或「明示保留」兩種方式成立。

points.en: An express easement is explicitly created in writing, typically through an express grant or an express reservation.
points.zh: 由供役地業主主動讓與/授予需役地業主，通常透過金錢買賣達成（例如支付鄰居 500 美元以取得在其土地延伸建造車道的權利）。

notes.body:
Express Grant（明示授與）: Given by the servient owner to the dominant owner, usually bargained and paid for (e.g., paying a neighbor $500 for the right to build an extended driveway onto their property).
Express Reservation（明示保留）: Created when a single landowner subdivides a parcel and retains an easement over the sold portion to maintain access to the retained land (e.g., selling lakeside acreage while reserving a road easement to reach the water from the western homestead).
ZH: 地主在分割土地並出售部分地塊時，於契約中明示為自己保留通過該讓與地塊的通行權（例如出售靠湖側土地時，保留自西側住宅穿越至湖邊的道路地役權）。
notes.sentenceEn: When a grantor divides a contiguous tract of land and transfers ownership of the outer portion while explicitly reserving a right-of-way in the instrument of conveyance to maintain direct lake access for the retained homestead, an express easement by reservation is formally and legally established.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 contiguous tract、explicitly reserving a right-of-way、instrument of conveyance 等契據用語。)

notes.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
notes.title: 三、EASEMENT BY NECESSITY（必要地役權）
notes.titleZh: 必要地役權

points.en: A court-created easement arising when a parcel of land is completely landlocked without any reasonable legal access to a public road. It lasts only for as long as the necessity exists and is extinguished if alternative public road access becomes available.
points.zh: 由法院判決創設的地役權，發生於土地完全閉鎖（Landlocked）而無任何合法途徑通往公共道路時。此地役權僅在「必要性存在期間」有效；一旦未來有其他道路開通而消除閉鎖狀態，該必要地役權即告消滅（Extinguished）。

notes.sentenceEn: Because public policy strongly disfavors landlocked parcels that lack reasonable ingress and egress, the court will declare an easement by necessity over the adjacent tract; however, the moment the municipal authorities construct an alternative public roadway providing direct access, the underlying necessity ceases and the easement is automatically extinguished.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 landlocked parcels、disfavors、underlying necessity ceases、automatically extinguished 等法理表述。)

notes.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
notes.title: 四、EASEMENT IN GROSS（個人地役權 / 無需役地地役權）
notes.titleZh: 個人地役權 / 無需役地地役權

points.en: Involves only one property (the servient estate) and has no dominant property. It attaches to a specific individual or legal entity rather than to the land itself.
points.zh: 僅涉及一筆受負擔之供役地，不存在需役地。該權利附屬於特定的自然人或法人實體，而非附隨於某一筆特定土地。

points.en: Involves only one property (the servient estate) and has no dominant property. It attaches to a specific individual or legal entity rather than to the land itself.
points.zh: 最常見於自來水、電力、瓦斯或電信公用事業公司，使其得以跨越私人土地鋪設與維護管線設施。它不會隨相鄰土地買賣而作為從屬權利移轉。

notes.body: Commercial Utility Usage: Commonly held by utility, pipeline, or telephone companies to cross private land to maintain public infrastructure. It does not transfer with title as an appurtenance when adjacent land is sold.
notes.sentenceEn: Unlike an appurtenant easement which benefits a dominant tenement and transfers with the underlying title, an easement in gross is a personal or commercial interest held by an entity, such as a municipal utility company, burdening a single servient parcel without conferring benefits upon an adjacent dominant property.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 comparing "appurtenant" 与 "in gross"、conferring benefits upon、single servient parcel 等概念對比。)

notes.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
notes.title: 五、IMPLIED EASEMENT（默示地役權）
notes.titleZh: 默示地役權

points.en: An unrecorded easement created by courts when properties are divided and both parties' apparent and continuous conduct indicates an obvious mutual intention that an easement should exist (such as for light, air, or historic driveway usage).
points.zh: 當土地分割出售但未訂立書面明示地役權時，法院依據雙方先前明顯且連續之使用行為所推定的未登記地役權（例如採光、通風或長期使用的車道通行權）。

notes.body:
五大成立要件（Requirements to Establish）：
Unity of prior ownership（需役地與供役地原先屬於同一所有人）。
Apparent（使用狀態外觀明顯可見）。
In existence at the time of the grant（讓與時該使用狀態已實質存在）。
Permanent（具有永久使用性質）。
Continuous and reasonably necessary to the enjoyment of the property（具有連續性且對該地產之正常使用具合理必要性）。
notes.sentenceEn: To successfully establish an implied easement following the subdivision of land, the claimant must demonstrate prior unity of title, proving that the disputed use was apparent, continuous, in active existence at the time of conveyance, and reasonably necessary for the beneficial enjoyment of the property.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 prior unity of title、disputed use、beneficial enjoyment of the property 等證明要件。)

notes.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
notes.title: 六、PRESCRIPTIVE EASEMENT（時效地役權）
notes.titleZh: 時效地役權

points.en: An easement acquired through open, notorious, adverse (hostile), and continuous use of another's land for a statutory period of time without the owner's permission.
points.zh: 未經地主許可，在他人土地上以公開、公然、對抗（敵對）且連續之方式使用達法定年限而取得之地役權。

points.en: An easement acquired through open, notorious, adverse (hostile), and continuous use of another's land for a statutory period of time without the owner's permission.
points.zh: 使用方式必須完全顯著且不可隱蔽（例如肉眼可見的越界車道，而非趁半夜偷偷抄捷徑）。

notes.body:
Open & Notorious（公開且公然）: The use must be clearly visible and not concealed (e.g., a visible boundary driveway, not sneaking across at 2 AM).
Adverse & Hostile（敵對 / 未獲授權）: Must occur completely without the owner's permission (if the owner grants verbal permission, it becomes a license and defeats prescription).
ZH: 必須是在「未取得地主許可」之狀態下使用（若地主同意，即轉為特許權 License，無法主張時效地役權）。
Continuous for Statutory Period（連續達法定期間）: Must occur on a regular basis for the state-mandated number of years (continuous does not require 24/7 constant use).
ZH: 依該州法定期限維持常規且不間斷的使用（連續並不等於每分每秒不間斷）。
notes.sentenceEn: To acquire a prescriptive easement across a neighboring parcel, the claimant must prove by clear evidence that the unauthorized usage of the path was open, notorious, hostile to the true owner's property rights, and continuously maintained without express permission throughout the entire statutory prescription period.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 hostile to the true owner's property rights、statutory prescription period、open and notorious 等高頻考點。)

notes.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
notes.title: 七、GOVERNMENT POWER & THE 4 POWERS（政府四大公權力：PETE）
notes.titleZh: 政府四大公權力：PETE

points.en: Private property ownership is always subordinate to four fundamental sovereign powers summarized by the acronym PETE:
points.zh: 個人土地所有權恆受政府四大最高主權限制，縮寫為 PETE：

notes.body:
P - Police Power（警察權）: The authority of the state to regulate private conduct and property use to protect public health, safety, morals, and general welfare without paying compensation (e.g., zoning ordinances, building codes, rent control).
E - Eminent Domain（徵收權）: The power to take private real estate for public use upon payment of "just compensation" (fair market value).
T - Taxation（徵稅權）: Financial charges assessed on real estate to fund government services and infrastructure.
E - Escheat（充公 / 產權歸公）: The reversion of property to the state when an individual dies intestate (without a will) and with no lawful heirs, ensuring property never remains ownerless (revocable if rightful heirs later appear).
Police Power（警察權）：為維護公共衛生、安全、道德與社會福祉而管制土地之權力，無須給予金錢補償（如分區法規、建築安全規範、租金管制）。
Eminent Domain（徵收權）：為公共利益而強制徵收私人房產的權力，必須給予合理補償（公平市價）。
Taxation（徵稅權）：對房地產課徵稅賦以支應公共建設與服務。
Escheat（產權充公）：業主身故無遺囑且無合法繼承人時，物業自動回歸州政府所有以確保土地永遠有主（若日後合法繼承人出現，此充公可撤銷返還）。
notes.sentenceEn: While the constitutional exercise of police power permits local municipalities to enact strict zoning regulations and building codes to safeguard public welfare without any requirement to provide financial compensation, the exercise of eminent domain fundamentally mandates the payment of fair market value whenever private land is appropriated for public use.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 police power（不需補償）與 eminent domain（必須補償）的法律責任對比。)

notes.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
notes.title: 八、ZONING & LAND USE REGULATIONS（分區管制與土地使用法規）
notes.titleZh: 分區管制與土地使用法規

points.en: Zoning is a local government police power regulation of private land use executed pursuant to a comprehensive master development plan; there are no federal zoning laws.
points.zh: 分區管制是地方政府依據長期總體總體規劃（Master Plan）行使警察權對土地進行之管制；聯邦層級並無分區法規。

points.en: Zoning is a local government police power regulation of private land use executed pursuant to a comprehensive master development plan; there are no federal zoning laws.
points.zh: 住宅區（如 R-3 多戶住宅）、商業區、農業區、工業區，以及特殊用途物業（如學校、醫院、警察局等公共利益建物）。

notes.body:
Core Categories（五大土地分區）: Residential (e.g., R-3 multi-family), Commercial, Agricultural, Industrial, and Special Purpose Properties (e.g., schools, hospitals, police stations for public benefit).
Zoning Regulatory Concepts（分區管制專用術語）：
Setback（建築退縮線）: The mandatory minimum distance between a structure and the street curb, sidewalk, or boundary line.
Density（建蔽密度）: Subdivisional limit specifying the maximum number of dwellings permitted per acre.
Floor Area Ratio (FAR)（容積率）: Ratio comparing building gross square footage to the total underlying land area.
Buffer vs. Buffer Zone（緩衝物 vs. 緩衝區）: A buffer is a physical barrier between two lots (wall, fence, trees), whereas a buffer zone is a dedicated tract of land (park, highway) separating two incompatible zoning districts.
Down-zoning（降級分區 / 調降密度）: Amending zoning to allow less intensive development (e.g., rezoning commercial to residential).
Variance（分區特許 / 變異許可）: An administrative exception granted to a specific lot owner suffering unique hardship to deviate from setback or dimensional rules without compromising community safety.
notes.sentenceEn: When an unusually shaped residential parcel cannot accommodate standard construction due to strict setbacks enforced by local zoning ordinances, the property owner may petition the zoning board of adjustment for a variance, which provides an individual exception to prevent undue practical hardship without adversely affecting the general welfare of the neighborhood.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 zoning board of adjustment、variance、undue practical hardship、adversely affecting 等申辦特許用語。)

notes.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
notes.title: 九、EMINENT DOMAIN, CONDEMNATION & INVERSE CONDEMNATION（徵收權、徵收程序與反向徵收）
notes.titleZh: 徵收權、徵收程序與反向徵收

points.en: A lawsuit filed by a private property owner against the government seeking just compensation when public actions effectively take, damage, or diminish the utility of private property without initiating formal condemnation proceedings (e.g., widening a highway and eliminating a retail market's entire parking lot, destroying its commercial viability).
points.zh: 當政府公共工程實質侵害、佔用或毀損私人房產價值（如拓寬大道佔用商場全部停車場導致其無法營業），卻未主動提起徵收及給予合理賠償時，由私有地主主動向法院起訴政府要求徵收補償的訴訟。

notes.body:
Eminent Domain vs. Condemnation（徵收權力 vs. 徵收程序）:
Eminent Domain: The underlying legal right/power of the government or authorized public utilities to take private property for public use.
Condemnation: The actual formal administrative/legal judicial process through which property title is transferred to the government and "just compensation" (fair market value) is determined.
ZH: Eminent Domain 是政府擁有的「徵收權利/權力」；Condemnation 則是執行產權轉移與裁定「合理補償金（Just Compensation）」的「法定徵收程序」。
Property Condemned vs. Condemnation（危樓查封 vs. 徵收程序）:
A building "condemned" for severe structural hazards or safety violations restricts occupancy and requires remediation under police power (title remains with the owner), whereas a "condemnation proceeding" transfers legal title to the government.
ZH: 因結構危險被宣告為「危樓查封（Condemned）」係基於警察權，屋主保有產權但需負擔修繕責任；而「徵收（Condemnation）」則是產權強制轉移予政府。
Inverse Condemnation（反向徵收 / 倒求徵收補償）:
—--------------
notes.sentenceEn: When municipal transit construction severely obstructs physical access or entirely deprives a commercial business of its customer parking facilities without the municipality initiating formal condemnation proceedings, the aggrieved landowner may file an action in inverse condemnation to compel the government to pay just compensation for the constructive taking of the entire property.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 inverse condemnation、compel the government to pay just compensation、constructive taking 等訴訟用語。)

notes.title: 一、AGENCY & REALTOR DEFINITIONS（代理總論與房地產經紀人定義）
notes.titleZh: 代理總論與房地產經紀人定義

points.en: The term "Realtor" is a specific trade mark referring to a licensed professional who is a member of the designated National Association of Realtors (or local board of realtors); non-members cannot legally claim to be Realtors.
points.zh: 「Realtor」為特定行業商標，專指加入全國房地產經紀人協會（或地方經紀人公會）的持牌會員；非會員依法不得自稱為 Realtor。

points.en: The term "Realtor" is a specific trade mark referring to a licensed professional who is a member of the designated National Association of Realtors (or local board of realtors); non-members cannot legally claim to be Realtors.
points.zh: 包含經紀代理（Agency/Broker）（受聘代表客戶之經紀機構）、委託人/客戶（Principal/Client）（聘請經紀人處理買賣或租賃事務的當事人） 以及第三人/顧客（Third Persons/Customers）（交易中非委託客戶之相對人）。

notes.body:
Parties in Agency Law（代理法三大主體）:
Agency / Broker: The real estate broker who represents a client for specific purposes.
Principal / Client: The person or corporation (seller, buyer, landlord, tenant, lender, borrower) who hires the broker to perform specific representation services.
Third Persons / Customers: Individuals or associations other than the broker's client with whom the broker interacts on behalf of the client.
notes.sentenceEn: Under the common law of agency governing real estate transactions, a licensed broker acting on behalf of a principal owes absolute fiduciary duties exclusively to that client, while concurrently maintaining a statutory obligation to deal honestly, fairly, and in good faith with all unrepresented third parties involved in the negotiation.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 common law of agency、fiduciary duties exclusively to that client、unrepresented third parties、good faith 等考題對比用語。)

notes.title: 二、BASICS OF THE RELATIONSHIP & ACOLD（代理關係基礎與受託人義務）
notes.titleZh: 代理關係基礎與受託人義務

points.en: An agency relationship creates a fiduciary relationship of trust and confidence where the principal is legally bound by the authorized acts of the agent.
points.zh: 代理關係會建立一種基於信任與信賴的受託人信託關係（Fiduciary Relationship），委託人依法須為代理人授權範圍內之行為承擔法律責任。

points.en: An agency relationship creates a fiduciary relationship of trust and confidence where the principal is legally bound by the authorized acts of the agent.
points.zh: 交易過程中代理身分若有任何變更，必須以書面形式揭露並取得當事人書面同意。

notes.body:
Creation of Agency（代理關係之成立途徑）：
Express Agreement: Written or oral contract.（明示協議：書面或口頭約定）。
Implication: Based on trade custom, practice, and actions.（默示成立：基於行業慣例與實務行為）。
Estoppel: Principal's conduct leads a third party to believe an agency exists; under equitable estoppel, the principal is legally prevented from denying it.（禁反言原則：因委託人言行使第三人產生信賴時，委託人依法不得否認代理關係存在）。
Fiduciary Duties (Acronym: ACOLD)（五大受託人信託義務）：
A - Accountable: Properly account for all funds and property entrusted to the broker.（交代帳目/妥善保管款項）。
C - Care & Skill: Exercise reasonable care, diligence, and professional skill.（合理注意與專業技能）。
O - Obey: Obey all lawful, legal instructions given by the principal.（服從委託人之合法指示）。
L - Loyalty: Place the principal's financial interests above all others, and maintain strict confidentiality regarding facts that could harm their bargaining position (e.g., pending divorce, urgent relocation).（絕對忠誠：嚴格保密議價底線或個人隱私，如離婚訴訟）。
D - Disclose: Promptly disclose all material and pertinent information affecting the transaction.（全面揭露一切交易實質重要資訊）。
Disclosure of Changes: Any change in agency representation must be disclosed in writing and consented to by the parties.
notes.sentenceEn: Under the strict fiduciary duty of undivided loyalty codified within the ACOLD framework, an agent representing a motivated seller is legally prohibited from disclosing to prospective buyers that the seller is undergoing a contentious divorce or facing imminent foreclosure, as revealing such confidential details would materially undermine the principal's negotiating leverage.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 undivided loyalty、codified within、contentious divorce、undermine the principal's negotiating leverage 等經典情境題幹。)

notes.title: 三、DUAL AGENCY（雙重代理）
notes.titleZh: 雙重代理

points.en: Occurs when a real estate broker represents both the buyer and the seller in the same transaction.
points.zh: 指同一個房地產經紀機構（Broker）在同一筆交易中同時代表買方與賣方。

notes.body:
Legal Structure & Common Pitfall（核心法律架構與易混淆點）:
Clients technically hire the brokerage firm / managing broker, not the individual salesperson. Thus, if Agent A represents the seller and Agent B represents the buyer, but both agents hang their licenses under the same supervising broker, it is legally a Dual Agency.
委託人在法律上聘僱的是經紀公司/主管經紀人而非個別業務員。因此，若買方代理人與賣方代理人隸屬於同一家經紀公司，法律上仍構成雙重代理。
Conflicts & Regulations（利益衝突與管制規範）:
Dual agency creates inherent conflicts of interest and is strictly illegal in some states.
In states where permitted, the broker must provide full written disclosure to, and obtain informed written consent from, both the buyer and the seller before proceeding.
雙重代理具潛在利益衝突，在部分州屬違法；在合法州別中，必須取得買賣雙方的事前書面充分揭露與書面同意（Written Consent）。
notes.sentenceEn: Because individual salespersons operate as subagents under their sponsoring brokerage firm, a dual agency legally materializes whenever two associated agents licensed under the same principal broker represent opposite sides of the identical real estate transaction, necessitating timely written disclosure and informed dual consent from both parties.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 subagents under their sponsoring brokerage firm、legally materializes、necessitating timely written disclosure、informed dual consent 等代理關係描述。)

notes.title: 四、UNIVERSAL, GENERAL, AND SPECIAL AGENTS（代理人三種權限類型）
notes.titleZh: 代理人三種權限類型
notes.body:
Universal Agent（全權代理人 / 總括代理人）: Authorized to perform all legal acts and make all decisions that the principal could personally perform (e.g., unlimited power of attorney).
獲委託人賦予全權，可代為執行委託人本人得為之所有一切法律行為。
General Agent（一般代理人 / 概括代理人）: Authorized by the principal to perform any and all acts associated with the ongoing, continuous operation of a specific job or business (e.g., a property manager managing an apartment complex).
獲授權在特定業務範圍內，持續處理與該業務營運相關之所有常態性事務（例如物業經理對屋主即為一般代理人）。
Special Agent / Limited Agent（特別代理人 / 特定代理人）: Authorized to conduct a single specific transaction or a limited set of acts with no expectation of a continuous business relationship (e.g., a real estate broker hired under a standard listing agreement to locate a ready, willing, and able buyer).
僅獲授權執行特定單一任務（如標準委託銷售契約中，經紀人僅獲授權尋找買方），不具持續性關係，任務完成或期限屆滿時代理關係即終止。
notes.sentenceEn: While a property manager functions as a general agent vested with ongoing operational authority to bind the landlord across routine property maintenance matters, a listing broker acts solely as a special agent with strictly limited authorization to market the real estate and procure prospective buyers without the legal capacity to execute the final sales contract on the owner's behalf.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 general agent vs. special agent、vested with ongoing operational authority、procure prospective buyers、legal capacity to execute 等對比邏輯。)

notes.title: 五、PRINCIPAL, CLIENT, CUSTOMER & ATTORNEY-IN-FACT（委託人、客戶、顧客與授權簽字人）
notes.titleZh: 委託人、客戶、顧客與授權簽字人
notes.body:
Client vs. Customer（客戶 vs. 顧客）:
A Client has executed a written representation agreement with the brokerage firm, creating direct fiduciary duties.
A Customer uses brokerage services (such as a buyer calling from a yard sign) without signing an agency agreement; the agent owes the customer honest, fair dealing and material disclosure, but no fiduciary loyalty.
客戶（Client） 簽署了書面代理約，享有完整的受託人信託義務保障；顧客（Customer） 則無代理合約，經紀人僅負有誠實、公平與實質揭露之義務，不負忠誠信託責任。
Representation & Commission（代理立場與佣金給付關係）:
A listing agreement binds the seller to the brokerage firm, not to the individual agent.
The buyer's broker remains a fiduciary to the buyer even if the seller pays the broker's commission via MLS cooperative splitting.
銷售契約之主體為經紀公司而非業務員個人；買方經紀人即使由賣方支付佣金，其代理立場與信託責任依然全歸屬於買方。
Attorney-in-Fact（授權代簽人 / 代理簽署人）:
A designated person legally empowered to sign documents on someone else's behalf under a written Power of Attorney (POA).
When signing legal instruments, the signature must explicitly identify the principal (e.g., "Bob, attorney-in-fact for Bill").
依據書面授權書（POA）取得代為簽字權限之人；在簽署法律文件時，簽名欄中必須同時明確載明委託人之姓名。
notes.sentenceEn: Notwithstanding the conventional industry practice wherein the seller provides the transactional commission funds distributed through the Multiple Listing Service, the selling broker who has executed a buyer representation agreement maintains an uncompromised fiduciary duty exclusively to the buyer-client throughout all contract negotiations.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 transactional commission funds、cooperative splitting、maintains an uncompromised fiduciary duty 等買方代理常考觀念。)

notes.title: 六、TYPES OF FRAUD & MISREPRESENTATION（各類詐欺與不實陳述）
notes.titleZh: 各類詐欺與不實陳述
notes.body:
Actual Fraud（實質詐欺 / 故意詐欺）: An intentional misrepresentation or deliberate false statement made to deceive another party into entering a contract (e.g., falsely asserting a damaged roof is brand new when knowing it leaks, or making a promise with zero intention of fulfilling it).
明知事實真相卻蓄意做出虛偽陳述以誘使他人簽約（例如明知屋頂漏水卻謊稱全新完好，或許下根本無意履行的空頭承諾）。
Negative Fraud / Fraud by Omission（消極詐欺 / 隱匿詐欺）: Deception through intentional silence or purposeful failure to disclose a known material defect that could cause financial, physical, or property harm (e.g., deflecting a direct question about foundation cracks).
透過蓄意隱匿、刻意不提重大瑕疵或轉移話題以誤導相對人簽約（例如買方詢問結構安全時刻意避重就輕）。
Constructive Fraud / Negligent Misrepresentation（推定詐欺 / 過失不實陳述）: A false statement of material fact made without actual malicious intent to deceive, but made carelessly or without verifying the facts (e.g., an agent innocently but incorrectly assuring a buyer that the roof is sound without checking or knowing the truth).
無蓄意欺瞞之惡意，但因疏忽、未經查證即率爾做出與事實不符之陳述（例如經紀人未加查證便向買方保證屋況良好，事後辯稱不知情）。
notes.sentenceEn: While actual fraud requires a deliberate intent to deceive through conscious affirmative falsehoods, constructive fraud arises when a licensee carelessly makes an inaccurate representation of a material fact without a reasonable factual basis, thereby inducing detrimental reliance by the buyer and subjecting the licensee to civil liabilities regardless of malicious intent.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 conscious affirmative falsehoods、constructive fraud、detrimental reliance（受損之信賴）、subjecting to civil liabilities 等法律名詞。)

notes.title: 七、NEGLIGENCE & PUFFING（過失責任與誇大吹捧）
notes.titleZh: 過失責任與誇大吹捧
notes.body:
Negligence（過失責任）: Failing to exercise a reasonable standard of care or perform a required duty due to carelessness, forgetfulness, or lack of time (e.g., an agent failing to verify accessible zoning status with the municipal department despite known zoning doubts).
因疏忽、遺忘或怠惰而未盡到法定之「合理注意義務」（例如已得知土地分區存疑，卻怠於致電市府查證）。
Liability: Agents and their supervising brokers/sellers can face civil damage awards and licensing board disciplinary suspension or revocation for negligent misrepresentations.
經紀人與主管經紀人/屋主均可能因過失陳述承擔民事損害賠償責任，經紀人亦可能面臨執照停吊處分。
Puffing（誇大吹捧 / 商業誇飾）: Exaggerated statements of personal opinion regarding non-material, subjective property qualities (e.g., claiming "this is the most charming cottage in town" or "this home has the best sunset view in the county").
針對物業主觀感受所做的個人誇飾性評價（例如宣稱「這是全鎮最迷人的小屋」或「擁有全縣最棒的落日景觀」）。
Legal Nature: Treated as non-factual sales talk and does not constitute actionable fraud or misrepresentation as long as it does not falsify material facts.
法律上視為一般行銷口吻，只要未虛構客觀重要事實，不構成違法詐欺。
notes.sentenceEn: In real estate marketing, mere puffing—characterized by subjective superlatives and non-factual sales rhetoric regarding property ambiance—is legally permissible, but once a licensee makes an unsupported factual assertion regarding objective zoning classifications or boundary lines, such conduct crosses the boundary into actionable negligence or misrepresentation.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 mere puffing、subjective superlatives、unsupported factual assertion、actionable negligence 等考題判定界線。)

notes.title: 八、STIGMATIZED PROPERTY（瑕疵心理性物業 / 凶宅與污名化房產）
notes.titleZh: 瑕疵心理性物業 / 凶宅與污名化房產

points.en: A property that buyers may find undesirable due to past emotional, psychological, or historical events unrelated to its physical condition or structural integrity (e.g., murders, suicides, alleged hauntings, or notorious criminal activity on the premises).
points.zh: 因過往發生的特定心理性、歷史性或非物理性事件而導致買方產生抗拒感的房產（例如曾發生謀殺、自殺、鬧鬼傳聞或重大刑案，但房屋實體結構本身並無損壞）。

points.en: A property that buyers may find undesirable due to past emotional, psychological, or historical events unrelated to its physical condition or structural integrity (e.g., murders, suicides, alleged hauntings, or notorious criminal activity on the premises).
points.zh: 賣方應依各州法定揭露規範，主動或如實揭露此類涉及該房產歷史紀錄之重大心理瑕疵。

notes.body:
Seller Disclosure Duties: The seller has a legal responsibility to disclose known stigmatizing events in accordance with applicable state disclosure statutes.
—--
notes.sentenceEn: A stigmatized property is legally defined as real estate that suffers a reduction in marketability due to psychological or emotional factors unrelated to physical defects—such as a tragic homicide or widely publicized suicide occurring on site—imposing specific statutory disclosure duties upon the seller depending on state-specific real property disclosure statutes.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 psychological or emotional factors unrelated to physical defects、tragic homicide、statutory disclosure duties 等凶宅定義與揭露用語。)

notes.title: 一、CONTRACT BASICS & GENERAL CLAUSES（合約基礎與常見條款）
notes.titleZh: 合約基礎與常見條款

points.en: A contract is an oral or written agreement to do or not do a certain thing. Under the Statute of Frauds, most real estate contracts (e.g., sales contracts, deeds, mortgages) must be in writing to be legally enforceable.
points.zh: 合約是承諾作為或不作為特定事項的口頭或書面協議。依據反詐欺法（Statute of Frauds），絕大多數不動產契約（如買賣合約、契據、抵押設定等）必須具備書面形式始具法律強制執行力。

points.en: A contract is an oral or written agreement to do or not do a certain thing. Under the Statute of Frauds, most real estate contracts (e.g., sales contracts, deeds, mortgages) must be in writing to be legally enforceable.
points.zh: 若合約未約定履行期，法律推定以「合理時間」履行。合約若載明「時間至關重要（Time is of the essence）」，則任何義務均須嚴格於約定期限內完成；逾期即構成實質違約，受約人有權解除合約。

notes.body:
Time for Performance & Time is of the Essence（履行期限與時間至關重要條款）: If no time period is specified, the law allows a reasonable time. When "Time is of the Essence" is written, all contractual duties must be strictly performed within the designated timeframe; failure to meet dates constitutes a material breach, entitling the promisee to cancel.
"As Is" Clause（現況交屋條款）: The buyer accepts the property in its existing condition. While it relieves the seller from an obligation to make physical repairs, it does NOT exempt the seller from the legal duty to disclose known latent material defects.
ZH: 買方同意按簽約時之現況承接物業。該條款雖免除賣方修復瑕疵之義務，但絕不免除賣方依法主動揭露已知重大瑕疵之責任。
Assignment vs. Novation（合約轉讓 vs. 契約更新）: Assignment transfers contract rights and interests from an assignor to an assignee, but leaves the assignor secondarily liable unless a novation is executed. Novation substitutes a new party or new agreement for the existing one, completely releasing the original party from ongoing liability. Personal service contracts cannot be assigned.
ZH: 「轉讓（Assignment）」將權利自讓與人移轉給受讓人，但讓與人仍負次要責任；「契約更新（Novation）」則以新約取代舊約或更換主體，能徹底免除原當事人的法律責任。具個人勞務性質的合約不可轉讓。
Remedies for Breach（違約救濟途徑）:
Liquidated Damages Clause（預定違約金條款）: A contractual pre-agreement where the parties agree that earnest money may be retained by the seller as full compensation if the buyer breaches.
Specific Performance（強制履行之訴）: A legal court action to compel a defaulting party to complete the transaction exactly as promised in the contract (e.g., forcing a reluctant seller to convey title). Brokers cannot sue for specific performance.
Rescission（合約解除 / 返還原狀）: Mutual agreement between parties to waive remaining duties and cancel the contract, restoring both parties to their original pre-contractual positions.
ZH: 包含預定違約金條款（雙方約定買方違約時賣方得沒收誠意保證金）、強制履行之訴（起訴要求法院強制命令違約方依約履行交易，通常為買方告賣方；經紀人不得提出強制履行之訴） 以及解除合約（合意作廢契約並回復至締約前之原始法律狀態）。
notes.sentenceEn: Although an 'as is' provision in a residential purchase agreement explicitly relieves the seller from the financial responsibility of repairing discovered physical defects, it does not exempt them from statutory disclosures, and if the contract contains a strict 'time is of the essence' clause, the failure of either party to meet designated closing deadlines constitutes a material breach entitling the non-defaulting party to seek rescission or sue for specific performance.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 'as is' provision、statutory disclosures、material breach、seek rescission or sue for specific performance 等綜合考點。)

notes.title: 二、FOUR ESSENTIAL ELEMENTS OF A VALID CONTRACT（有效合約四大成立要件）
notes.titleEn: 二、FOUR ESSENTIAL ELEMENTS OF A VALID CONTRACT
notes.titleZh: 有效合約四大成立要件

points.en: A legally binding, enforceable contract must satisfy four fundamental legal requirements:
points.zh: 有效合約必須同時具備四大要件：

notes.body:
Capable Parties（具行為能力之當事人）: Parties must be at least 18 years of age and of sound mind. Also includes corporate authorized signers, attorneys-in-fact under power of attorney, appointed fiduciaries, and legally emancipated minors (via marriage, military enlistment, or judicial emancipation).
Lawful Object（合法標的）: The purpose and terms of the contract must be fully legal. Contracts entered into for illegal acts (e.g., a contract to commit a crime) are completely void from inception.
Consideration（對價關係）: Anything of legal value offered, bargained for, and received by the parties. Does not require cash; can take the form of goods, personal services, promises, or even "love and affection".
Offer and Acceptance / Mutual Consent（要約與承諾 / 意思表示一致）: Requires a genuine "meeting of the minds" with clear, precise terms and an exact, identifiable purchase price (vague descriptions or prices like "a whole lot of money" are invalid).
具行為能力之當事人：年滿 18 歲且心智健全（含公司合法代表、POA 代簽人、法定受託人以及透過結婚、從軍或法院裁定取得完全民事能力的自立未成年人 Emancipated minors）。
合法標的：契約目的必須完全合法，違法目的之合約自始無效。
對價：雙方約定給付具有法律價值的利益（金錢、物品、勞務承諾或「愛與親情」皆可）。
要約與承諾：雙方在明確無誤的條款與具體價格上達成合意（Meeting of the minds）。
Offer Termination & Counteroffers（要約終止與反要約）:
An offer is terminated by the death or mental incapacitation of the offeror or offeree prior to acceptance, destruction of the subject property, or material changes.
Any modification to the original offer made by the offeree constitutes a Counteroffer, which automatically rejects and terminates the original offer, reversing the legal positions of the parties.
要約在獲承諾前，若任一方身故、喪失行為能力、標的物毀損或條件重大變更則告終止；若受要約人修改原要約條件，即構成反要約（Counteroffer），原要約立即作廢失效，雙方要約身分互換並產生一份全新合約。
notes.sentenceEn: A legally enforceable real estate sales contract fundamentally requires capable parties possessing legal capacity, a lawful objective, sufficient bargained-for consideration, and mutual assent evidenced by an unequivocal offer and acceptance; hence, any unaccepted counteroffer proposed by the seller immediately acts as a legal rejection that permanently terminates the buyer's original offer.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 capable parties、lawful objective、mutual assent、unequivocal offer and acceptance、permanently terminates 等要件詞彙。)

notes.title: 三、CONTRACT VALIDITY: VALID, VOID, AND VOIDABLE（有效、無效與得撤銷合約）
notes.titleEn: 三、CONTRACT VALIDITY: VALID, VOID, AND VOIDABLE
notes.titleZh: 有效、無效與得撤銷合約
notes.body:
Valid Contract（有效合約）: Meets all essential legal elements and is fully enforceable in a court of law by all parties.
具備所有法定要件，在法律上完全具有拘束力與強制執行力。
Voidable Contract（得撤銷合約）: A contract that appears valid on its surface and remains legally binding unless and until it is rescinded/disaffirmed by the injured party who holds the legal option to void it.
表面有效且具拘束力，但受害方或享有撤銷權之一方保有將其撤銷作廢之選擇權。
Grounds for Voidability: Contracts containing contingency clauses that cannot be satisfied; contracts entered into under duress, menace, undue influence, misrepresentation, or fraud; and contracts entered into with minors (voidable at the minor's option).
得撤銷事由：附帶之免責/先決條件（Contingencies）無法成就；因受脅迫（Duress）、不當影響、不實陳述或詐欺而簽訂之合約；未成年人所簽署之合約（未成年人單方享有撤銷權）。
Void Contract（無效合約 / 自始無效）: Lacks one or more essential legal elements from the outset, possessing zero legal force or effect. Neither party can enforce it (e.g., illegal purpose, or a party adjudicated as mentally incompetent).
自始即欠缺法定必備要件，在法律上完全不產生任何效力，任一方均不得主張履行（如標的違法、當事人經法院宣告無行為能力）。
notes.sentenceEn: While a contract executed for an unlawful purpose or executed by a person legally declared mentally incompetent is completely void ab initio with zero legal standing, a real estate purchase agreement signed under duress or induced by material misrepresentation is merely voidable at the sole discretion of the aggrieved party.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：區分 void ab initio（自始無效）與 voidable at the sole discretion of the aggrieved party（受害方得自由決定是否撤銷）。)

notes.title: 四、EXECUTED VS. EXECUTORY & BILATERAL VS. UNILATERAL CONTRACTS（履約狀態與契約形式）
notes.titleEn: 四、EXECUTED VS. EXECUTORY & BILATERAL VS. UNILATERAL CONTRACTS
notes.titleZh: 履約狀態與契約形式
notes.body:
Executed Contract（已履行合約 / 已執行完畢合約）: All parties have completely performed and fulfilled all contractual obligations and covenants (e.g., a completed transaction where deed is delivered and funds are disbursed at closing). (Note: "Execution" of a document refers to the mere act of signing it).
所有當事人均已將約定之權利義務全數履行完畢（例如過戶交屋完成、款項結清之買賣約）。(注意：簽署文件之動作稱為 Execution)。
Executory Contract（待履行合約）: One or both contracting parties have ongoing, unperformed duties (e.g., a purchase contract during the escrow period before financing is approved and title is passed).
雙方或一方尚有未完成之合約義務（例如簽約後至過戶前，買方尚在申請貸款、賣方正在釐清產權之階段）。
Bilateral Contract（雙務契約）: An agreement formed through a mutual exchange of promises ("a promise for a promise"), binding both parties to performance (e.g., standard listing contracts, standard sales contracts).
雙方互負對價義務，以「承諾交換承諾」（如委託銷售契約中賣方承諾付佣、經紀人承諾尋找買方；一般買賣合約）。
Unilateral Contract（單務契約）: An agreement where only one party makes a legally binding promise in exchange for the actual performance of an act by the other ("a promise for an act"). The other party is not obligated to perform, but if they do, the promisor is bound (e.g., an unexercised option contract, a reward offer for a lost pet).
僅有一方做出具法律拘束力之承諾，以換取相對人之實質行動（如未行使前之選擇權契約 Option contract、懸賞廣告）。
notes.sentenceEn: A standard purchase agreement during the pending escrow period is classified as an executory, bilateral contract because mutual promises remain outstanding between buyer and seller, whereas an unexercised option contract represents a unilateral agreement where only the optionor is legally bound to perform until the optionee formally exercises their right to buy.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 executory, bilateral contract 與 unilateral agreement 之精準法律分類。)

notes.title: 五、SPECIFIC TYPES OF CONTRACTS: LAND CONTRACT, OPTION, AND IMPLIED（特定合約類型）
notes.titleEn: 五、SPECIFIC TYPES OF CONTRACTS: LAND CONTRACT, OPTION, AND IMPLIED
notes.titleZh: 特定合約類型
notes.body:
Land Contract / Contract for Deed（土地合約 / 分期付款買賣契約）:
A seller financing arrangement between a Vendor (seller) and Vendee (buyer) where the vendor retains Legal Title as a security device until the final payment is made.
The vendee receives immediate physical possession and holds Equitable Title (the legal right to obtain absolute legal title upon full financial performance).
The vendor is traditionally responsible for property taxes and hazard insurance because legal title remains in the vendor's name.
賣方融資型態之一，賣方（Vendor）保留法定產權（Legal Title）作為擔保直到最後一期付款結清；買方（Vendee）取得實際佔有使用權並持有衡平法產權（Equitable Title）。賣方通常負責繳納地產稅與保險。
Option Contract & Lease Option（選擇權契約與附買回選擇權租約）:
An agreement where the seller/landlord (Optionor) grants the buyer/tenant (Optionee) the right to purchase the property at a fixed price within a specified timeframe in exchange for non-refundable Consideration.
Starts as a unilateral contract; becomes a bilateral contract the moment the optionee formally exercises the option.
Assignable unless expressly prohibited by contract terms.
賣方/房東（Optionor）收取對價後，賦予買方/租客（Optionee）在特定期限內以約定價格購買該房產之權利。簽約時為單務契約，一旦租客行使選擇權即轉變為雙務契約。
Implied Contract（默示合約）:
A contract created not through explicit written or oral terms, but implied by law from the observable conduct, actions, and surrounding circumstances of the parties.
非透過明示書面或口頭訂立，而是由當事人之行為舉止與交易客觀情境所推定的合法合約。
notes.sentenceEn: Under an installment land contract, the vendor retains bare legal title as security for the debt while conveying equitable title and possession to the vendee, thereby conferring upon the buyer a beneficial ownership interest and the irrevocable legal right to demand a formal deed upon satisfaction of the final purchase payment.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 bare legal title、equitable title、beneficial ownership interest、upon satisfaction of final payment 等土地契約專業用語。)

notes.title: 六、LISTINGS & THE MULTIPLE LISTING SERVICE（委託銷售合約與 MLS 系統）
notes.titleZh: 委託銷售合約與 MLS 系統
notes.body:
Nature of a Listing Agreement（銷售委託之法律性質）:
An employment contract hiring a brokerage firm to find a ready, willing, and able buyer, NOT to physically sell the house or sign deeds on the owner's behalf.
It is a personal service contract that cannot be assigned to another broker.
Commission is paid to the broker, who then splits it with the associated agent or cooperating buyer's broker.
委託銷售約是屋主聘請經紀公司尋找買方的勞務僱傭契約，而非授權經紀人代為簽字出售房屋。屬個人勞務專屬契約，不可轉讓。佣金統一給付予經紀公司再行分拆。
Multiple Listing Service (MLS)（多重上市服務系統）:
A centralized cooperative marketing database where listing brokers share listings with cooperating brokers and agree to split commissions upon successful closing. Commission split terms must be fully disclosed to the seller.
經紀人間合作分享房源資訊的集中式資料庫，便於共同促成交易並拆分佣金（分佣比例必須向屋主充分揭露）。
Termination of Listings（委託銷售合約之終止事由）：
Expiration of the contractual termination date.
Mutual agreement between broker and seller.
Death or incapacitation of the principal (seller) or listing broker.
Destruction of the property (e.g., fire, disaster).
Material change affecting property value (e.g., municipal zoning change from residential to commercial).
Breach of duty by either party.
Protection Period Clause / Safety / Extender Clause（保護期條款 / 安全條款）:
Protects the broker's commission for a stipulated period after the listing expires if the property is sold to a buyer whom the broker originally introduced and showed the property to during the listing term.
在委託到期後的約定保護期內，若物業出售給經紀人在合約期內曾帶看並引薦之買方，經紀人仍有權索取全額佣金。
Listing with an Option & Licensee Purchases（附選擇權之委託與經紀人自購）:
A licensee must disclose their licensed status in writing before making an offer on a listed property or purchasing for their own portfolio, including any expected profit.
經紀人若欲購買自己代理之物業，必須事前以書面揭露其持牌身分及預期利潤。
notes.sentenceEn: Because a listing agreement constitutes a non-assignable personal service contract between a seller and a principal broker, the agreement automatically terminates upon the death of either party, property destruction, or a material change in zoning, but a properly drafted protection period clause preserves the broker's right to compensation if a procured buyer purchases the property shortly after expiration.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 non-assignable personal service contract、material change in zoning、protection period clause 等考題判定要點。)

notes.title: 1. Exclusive Authorization and Right to Sell Listing（獨家銷售權委託 / 專屬代理且獨家銷售）
notes.titleEn: 1. Exclusive Authorization and Right to Sell Listing（獨家銷售權委託 / 專屬代理且獨家銷售）

points.en: The broker is given the exclusive right to market the property and receives a commission regardless of who finds the buyer (even if the owner sells it independently to their own friend). The broker does NOT need to prove they were the "procuring cause". Must include a specific definite expiration date.
points.zh: 經紀公司享有獨家銷售權利，不論最終由誰（包含屋主本人）促成交易，經紀人皆可獲得約定佣金。經紀人無須證明自己為「促成交易之主因（Procuring Cause）」。合約必須訂立明確終止日期。

notes.title: 2. Exclusive Agency Listing（獨家代理委託）
notes.titleEn: 2. Exclusive Agency Listing（獨家代理委託）

points.en: The seller employs only one broker, but retains the right to sell the property personally without paying a commission. To earn compensation, the listing broker must prove they were the procuring cause of the sale.
points.zh: 屋主僅委託一家經紀公司，但保留自行尋找買方之權利；若屋主自行售出，無須支付經紀人任何佣金。經紀人必須證明自己是促成該筆交易的主因方能請領佣金。

notes.title: 3. Open Listing / Non-Exclusive Listing（非獨家委託 / 開放式委託）
notes.titleEn: 3. Open Listing / Non-Exclusive Listing（非獨家委託 / 開放式委託）

points.en: The owner lists the property with multiple competing brokers simultaneously and retains the right to sell independently. Only the specific broker who acts as the procuring cause of the accepted offer receives a commission; if the owner sells it first, no commissions are owed. Does not require a strict termination date.
points.zh: 屋主可同時與多家不同經紀公司簽約，亦可自售。唯有真正促成買賣成交的那一家經紀人能獲得佣金；若屋主自行售出，所有經紀人皆無佣金。通常無需明訂嚴格截止日期。

notes.title: 4. Net Listing（淨額委託銷售）

points.en: The seller specifies a predetermined net dollar amount they must receive from the sale; any excess proceeds above that net figure are retained by the listing broker as commission. Prohibited or heavily restricted in many jurisdictions due to inherent conflicts of interest.
points.zh: 屋主設定一個實收底價（Net Amount），成交價超出該底價之所有超額利潤全數作為經紀人之佣金。因易引發嚴重的利益衝突與道德風險，在許多州被明令禁止或受嚴格管制。

notes.sentenceEn: The fundamental legal distinction among residential listing agreements centers on commission entitlement: under an exclusive right to sell listing, the broker earns compensation regardless of whether the buyer was procured by the agent or the owner, whereas under an exclusive agency listing, the seller retains the express contractual right to procure a buyer independently without incurring any commission liability.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 exclusive right to sell vs. exclusive agency、regardless of who procured the buyer、incurring commission liability 等對比句構。)

notes.title: 八、EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT（履約保證金 / 誠意訂金）
notes.titleZh: 履約保證金 / 誠意訂金

points.en: Good faith deposit submitted by the prospective buyer alongside a purchase offer to demonstrate serious contractual intent (analogous to an engagement ring in a marriage proposal).
points.zh: 買方於提出買賣要約時一併給付之善意保證金，用以表明履約之誠意（性質如同求婚時的訂婚戒指）。

points.en: Good faith deposit submitted by the prospective buyer alongside a purchase offer to demonstrate serious contractual intent (analogous to an engagement ring in a marriage proposal).
points.zh: 誠意金並非合約成立的必要法定對價（雙方的承諾交換即為對價），但其作為預定違約金，若買方於免責期滿後無故違約，該保證金將面臨被賣方沒收之風險。

notes.body:
Legal Significance & Forfeiture Risk: Earnest money is NOT required to form a valid contract (contractual consideration is the exchange of mutual promises), but it provides established liquidated damages that the buyer risks forfeiting if they unlawfully breach the contract after contingencies have lapsed.
—----
notes.sentenceEn: Although an earnest money deposit is not a mandatory legal element required to validate an executory sales contract, it serves as tangible evidence of the buyer's good-faith intention to perform, and under standard liquidated damages provisions, it may be rightfully forfeited to the seller if the buyer unexcusedly defaults after all financing contingencies have been satisfied.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 tangible evidence of good-faith intention、liquidated damages provisions、rightfully forfeited、unexcusedly defaults 等履約保證金考點。)

notes.title: 一、DEPRECIATION & ITS CLASSIFICATIONS（折舊概念與可修復性分類）
notes.titleZh: 折舊概念與可修復性分類

points.en: Depreciation is defined as any loss in value of a property over time from any cause.
points.zh: 折舊指不動產因任何原因隨時間推移而產生的任何價值減損。

points.en: Depreciation is defined as any loss in value of a property over time from any cause.
points.zh: 稅法允許投資人針對地上改良物價值提列折舊以扣抵應稅所得。通常採「直線折舊法」計算，即假設改良物在其經濟壽命期間每年以固定等額速率折舊。

notes.body:
Tax Depreciation & Straight-Line Method（稅務折舊與直線折舊法）: Real estate investors are permitted under tax laws to depreciate the value of improvements to reduce taxable income. It is calculated using the straight-line method, which assumes equal annual depreciation over the improvement's economic life.
Curable vs. Incurable Depreciation（可修復折舊 vs. 不可修復折舊）:
Curable（可修復）: When the cost of repairing or correcting the defect adds an equal or greater amount to the overall property value (e.g., spending $5,000 on roof repair increases property value by $5,000 or more).
Incurable（不可修復）: When the cost to remedy the condition exceeds the economic value added to the property (e.g., spending $5,000 to fix a roof only adds $650 to value, or repairing severely compromised load-bearing walls).
ZH: 若修復成本能為物業帶來「等於或大於」該成本的增值，稱為可修復折舊（在財務上具可行性）；若修繕成本遠高於所能增加的市場價值（或涉及重大結構破壞），則屬不可修復折舊。
notes.sentenceEn: When evaluating property deterioration for appraisal purposes, physical defects are deemed economically curable only if the total expenditure required to remedy the condition contributes an equal or greater dollar increase to the overall market value of the real estate, whereas defects that cost significantly more to repair than the value they recover are classified as incurable.
notes.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 deemed economically curable、expenditure required to remedy、contributes an equal or greater dollar increase、classified as incurable 等條件對比句構。)

notes.title: 1. Economic Obsolescence / External Obsolescence（經濟性折舊 / 外部折舊）
notes.titleEn: 1. Economic Obsolescence / External Obsolescence（經濟性折舊 / 外部折舊）
