• Main Subject + Passive Voice: "annually cultivated agricultural crops (主詞) ... are classified as personal property (被動語態動詞與補語)"，表示「年度耕作之農作物被歸類為動產」。其中 resulting from a tenant farmer's labor 為分詞片語後位修飾 crops。
2. Participle Clause & Concession/Time Clause（分詞片語與時間從句）
• Present Participle ("thereby granting..."): 現在分詞片語引導結果說明，表示「從而賦予農民耕作與採收之默示法律權利」。
• Time Clause ("even after..."): 由 "even after" 引導副詞從句，說明「即使租款在生長季結束前意外終止」，該權利依然成立。
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 annually cultivated、implied legal right、unexpectedly terminated 等組合。)
sentences.hintZh: 租戶農民透過人工辛勤耕作的年度農作物。被視為動產（Personal Property）。依據農作物收益權法則，即使租約期滿或非因租客過錯而終止，農民仍保有於該生長季結束前返回土地採收其勞動成果的權利。

sentences.title: 9. Water Rights & Water Alteration Terms（水權及水體物理變動）
sentences.titleZh: 水權及水體物理變動
sentences.en: In jurisdictions governed by traditional common law water doctrines, riparian owners along flowing streams hold reasonable use rights that differ distinctly from littoral owners along stationary lakes, while in arid western states, the doctrine of prior appropriation supersedes these riparian privileges by granting superior water rights based strictly on the historical date of beneficial use rather than geographic adjacency.
sentences.grammar:
1. Main Clause（主句結構）
• Subject + Verb + Object: "riparian owners (主詞) ... hold (動詞) reasonable use rights (賓語)..."
• 中文解析: 「沿岸土地所有權人擁有合理使用水資源的權利」。主句明確指出沿岸業主所擁有的核心法律權利。
2. Contrast Clause with 'while'（使用 'while' 的對比從句）
• Adversative Conjunction ("while..."): 用來引導與主句形成對比的法律規則："while in arid western states, the doctrine of prior appropriation supersedes these riparian privileges..."（然而在乾燥的西部各州，優先佔有原則取代了這些沿岸權利）。
3. Prepositional Modifiers（介系詞修飾語）
• Introductory Prepositional Phrase: "In jurisdictions governed by traditional common law water doctrines..."（在受傳統普通法水權法則管轄的管轄區內），修飾整個句子，說明適用之法律背景。
• Prepositional Phrases for Basis & Contrast: "based strictly on the historical date..."（嚴格依據歷史使用日期）與 "rather than geographic adjacency"（而非地理上的相鄰關係），分別用來修飾水權的分配依據與排他條件。
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：區分 reasonable use rights、prior appropriation、geographic adjacency 等常見比較題用語。)

sentences.title: 2. Fee Simple Absolute（完全所有權 / 絕對無條件繼承地產）
sentences.titleZh: 完全所有權 / 絕對無條件繼承地產
sentences.en: A fee simple absolute represents the maximum possible estate a person can hold in real property, granting the holder perpetual ownership and unlimited rights of disposition that cannot be defeated by previous owners or their heirs, subject solely to public limitations like taxation and private encumbrances such as recorded liens.
sentences.grammar:
1. Main Clause（主句結構）
• Subject + Verb + Predicate: "A fee simple absolute (主詞) represents (動詞) the maximum possible estate (賓語)..."
• 中文解析: 主句說明「完全所有權代表了一個人在不動產中所能持有的最大可能地產」。
2. Participle Modifier & Relative Clause（分詞修飾語與關係從句）
• Present Participle ("granting..."): 現在分詞片語作為補充說明，表示該產權賦予持有人永久所有權與無限處分權。
• Relative Clause ("that cannot be defeated..."): 關係代名詞 that 修飾前方的 rights of disposition，說明這些處分權利無法被前手所有權人或其繼承人推翻/廢除。
3. Prepositional Modifier ("subject solely to...")（限制條件修飾語）
• Adjective Phrase ("subject solely to..."): 修飾前面的所有權與處分權，表示此類權利「僅受制於」公共限制（如課稅）與私人負擔（如已登記的留置權）。
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 maximum possible estate、perpetual ownership、cannot be defeated by 等核心描述。)
sentences.hintZh: 法律所承認最高級、最完整且無附加限制的產權。可自由由繼承人繼承，絕不因任何特定條件而自動回歸讓與人，僅受政府四大權力（PETE）及約定之物權負擔限制。

sentences.title: 3. Fee Simple Defeasible（可廢止 / 附條件繼承地產）
sentences.titleZh: 可廢止 / 附條件繼承地產
sentences.en: A fee simple determinable automatically ends and reverts to the original grantor without requiring judicial intervention if the specific restrictive limitation (such as maintaining the land solely for educational purposes) is breached, whereas a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent mandates that the grantor affirmatively exercise a right of re-entry to extinguish the estate.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 automatically ends and reverts、judicial intervention、affirmatively exercise a right of re-entry 等考題辨析重點。)
sentences.hintZh: 讓與人在地契中附加特定條件或限制的所有權。一旦違反條款，產權可能被撤銷沒收。「限定決定產權」在條件發生時自動回歸讓與人；「解除條件產權」則需由讓與人主動採取法律行動重新進入並主張收回產權。

sentences.title: 4. Life Estate & Pur Autre Vie（終身地產 / 終身權）
sentences.titleZh: 終身地產 / 終身權
sentences.en: Although a life tenant has the legitimate authority to mortgage, lease, or enjoy the physical fruits of the real property for the duration of the measuring life, they cannot devise the underlying fee simple title in a will, and they are strictly bound by fiduciary-like obligations not to commit waste that would diminish the value of the future interest held by the remainderman.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 measuring life、devise the underlying title、commit waste、remainderman 等專業術語。)
sentences.hintZh: 存續期間以受領人或指定第三人之生命長度為準的產權。身故後產權歸還原讓與人者稱為「回復權（Reversion）」；轉移給第三人者稱為「剩餘權（Remainder）」。終身權人負有納稅與維持物業之義務，嚴禁造成損耗/毀損（Waste）。終身權人不得立遺囑處分該物業，其所簽訂的租約或抵押於其身故時全數終止。

sentences.title: 1. Four Types of Leasehold Estates（四類租賃權型態）
sentences.titleZh: 四類租賃權型態
sentences.en: The fundamental legal distinction between an estate for years and a periodic tenancy lies in the termination mechanism: an estate for years automatically self-terminates upon the arrival of its predetermined calendar date without requiring any formal notice, whereas a periodic tenancy continually rolls over into consecutive periods until affirmative statutory notice is formally served by either lessor or lessee.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 self-terminates upon、consecutive periods、affirmative statutory notice is formally served 等對比句構。)
sentences.hintZh: 具有確定開始與結束日期的定期租賃（例如 6 個月短租或 5 年商業約）。租期屆滿自動終止，無須發出終止通知。

sentences.title: 2. Leases, Covenants & Eviction Concepts（租約法律原則、約定條款與驅逐）
sentences.titleZh: 租約法律原則、約定條款與驅逐
sentences.en: If a residential landlord deliberately neglects essential repairs to the extent that the premises become legally uninhabitable—such as by failing to furnish mandatory heating in winter—the tenant may declare a constructive eviction, surrender physical possession, and be completely relieved of future rental liabilities under the lease agreement.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 become legally uninhabitable、declare a constructive eviction、surrender physical possession、relieved of rental liabilities 等因果關聯詞。)

sentences.title: 3. Property Management（物業管理原則）
sentences.titleZh: 物業管理原則
sentences.en: Operating as a general agent under a written management contract, a professional property manager owes broad fiduciary duties to the property owner, with the principal objective of maximizing the net operating income while implementing effective risk management strategies—such as transferring catastrophic exposure to insurance carriers and controlling localized risks through modern life-safety installations.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 broad fiduciary duties、net operating income、transferring catastrophic exposure、controlling localized risks 等商業物管專用詞彙。)

sentences.title: 4. Commercial & Residential Types of Leases（租賃合約類型）
sentences.titleZh: 租賃合約類型
sentences.en: Under a triple net (NNN) lease commonly utilized in commercial real estate, the tenant assumes the contractual obligation to pay a base rental amount in addition to real estate taxes, hazard insurance, and property maintenance, whereas in a percentage lease, commercial rent fluctuates dynamically based on a stipulated percentage of the business's gross receipts.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 assumes the contractual obligation to pay、fluctuates dynamically based on、stipulated percentage 等商業租賃題幹關鍵句式。)
sentences.hintZh: 承租人每月支付固定租金；出租人（房東）負責支付所有的地產稅、保險、結構維修及日常營運開支（住宅市場最普遍）。

sentences.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
sentences.title: 一、EASEMENTS（地役權總論與附屬地役權）
sentences.titleZh: 地役權總論與附屬地役權
sentences.en: An appurtenant easement creates an incorporeal right attached to the dominant estate that burdens the adjacent servient estate, granting essential ingress and egress rights that legally run with the land and automatically convey to subsequent grantees, regardless of whether specifically referenced in the deed.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 dominant estate、servient estate、ingress and egress、runs with the land 等搭配。)
sentences.hintZh: 地役權指為特定目的（例如通行或公用設施）而使用他人土地的合法權利。地役權具「附隨於土地（Runs with the land）」之性質，產權移轉時自動轉給新所有人，且必須以書面為之。核心術語包括 Ingress（進入權）與 Egress（外出/離開權）。

sentences.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
sentences.title: 二、EXPRESS EASEMENTS（明示地役權）
sentences.titleZh: 明示地役權
sentences.en: When a grantor divides a contiguous tract of land and transfers ownership of the outer portion while explicitly reserving a right-of-way in the instrument of conveyance to maintain direct lake access for the retained homestead, an express easement by reservation is formally and legally established.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 contiguous tract、explicitly reserving a right-of-way、instrument of conveyance 等契據用語。)
sentences.hintZh: 明示地役權是以書面明確訂立的地役權，主要透過「明示授與」或「明示保留」兩種方式成立。

sentences.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
sentences.title: 三、EASEMENT BY NECESSITY（必要地役權）
sentences.titleZh: 必要地役權
sentences.en: Because public policy strongly disfavors landlocked parcels that lack reasonable ingress and egress, the court will declare an easement by necessity over the adjacent tract; however, the moment the municipal authorities construct an alternative public roadway providing direct access, the underlying necessity ceases and the easement is automatically extinguished.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 landlocked parcels、disfavors、underlying necessity ceases、automatically extinguished 等法理表述。)
sentences.hintZh: 由法院判決創設的地役權，發生於土地完全閉鎖（Landlocked）而無任何合法途徑通往公共道路時。此地役權僅在「必要性存在期間」有效；一旦未來有其他道路開通而消除閉鎖狀態，該必要地役權即告消滅（Extinguished）。

sentences.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
sentences.title: 四、EASEMENT IN GROSS（個人地役權 / 無需役地地役權）
sentences.titleZh: 個人地役權 / 無需役地地役權
sentences.en: Unlike an appurtenant easement which benefits a dominant tenement and transfers with the underlying title, an easement in gross is a personal or commercial interest held by an entity, such as a municipal utility company, burdening a single servient parcel without conferring benefits upon an adjacent dominant property.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 comparing "appurtenant" 与 "in gross"、conferring benefits upon、single servient parcel 等概念對比。)
sentences.hintZh: 僅涉及一筆受負擔之供役地，不存在需役地。該權利附屬於特定的自然人或法人實體，而非附隨於某一筆特定土地。

sentences.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
sentences.title: 五、IMPLIED EASEMENT（默示地役權）
sentences.titleZh: 默示地役權
sentences.en: To successfully establish an implied easement following the subdivision of land, the claimant must demonstrate prior unity of title, proving that the disputed use was apparent, continuous, in active existence at the time of conveyance, and reasonably necessary for the beneficial enjoyment of the property.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 prior unity of title、disputed use、beneficial enjoyment of the property 等證明要件。)
sentences.hintZh: 當土地分割出售但未訂立書面明示地役權時，法院依據雙方先前明顯且連續之使用行為所推定的未登記地役權（例如採光、通風或長期使用的車道通行權）。

sentences.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
sentences.title: 六、PRESCRIPTIVE EASEMENT（時效地役權）
sentences.titleZh: 時效地役權
sentences.en: To acquire a prescriptive easement across a neighboring parcel, the claimant must prove by clear evidence that the unauthorized usage of the path was open, notorious, hostile to the true owner's property rights, and continuously maintained without express permission throughout the entire statutory prescription period.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 hostile to the true owner's property rights、statutory prescription period、open and notorious 等高頻考點。)
sentences.hintZh: 未經地主許可，在他人土地上以公開、公然、對抗（敵對）且連續之方式使用達法定年限而取得之地役權。

sentences.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
sentences.title: 七、GOVERNMENT POWER & THE 4 POWERS（政府四大公權力：PETE）
sentences.titleZh: 政府四大公權力：PETE
sentences.en: While the constitutional exercise of police power permits local municipalities to enact strict zoning regulations and building codes to safeguard public welfare without any requirement to provide financial compensation, the exercise of eminent domain fundamentally mandates the payment of fair market value whenever private land is appropriated for public use.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 police power（不需補償）與 eminent domain（必須補償）的法律責任對比。)
sentences.hintZh: 個人土地所有權恆受政府四大最高主權限制，縮寫為 PETE：

sentences.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
sentences.title: 八、ZONING & LAND USE REGULATIONS（分區管制與土地使用法規）
sentences.titleZh: 分區管制與土地使用法規
sentences.en: When an unusually shaped residential parcel cannot accommodate standard construction due to strict setbacks enforced by local zoning ordinances, the property owner may petition the zoning board of adjustment for a variance, which provides an individual exception to prevent undue practical hardship without adversely affecting the general welfare of the neighborhood.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 zoning board of adjustment、variance、undue practical hardship、adversely affecting 等申辦特許用語。)
sentences.hintZh: 分區管制是地方政府依據長期總體總體規劃（Master Plan）行使警察權對土地進行之管制；聯邦層級並無分區法規。

sentences.chapter: 地役權、公權力與土地管制
sentences.title: 九、EMINENT DOMAIN, CONDEMNATION & INVERSE CONDEMNATION（徵收權、徵收程序與反向徵收）
sentences.titleZh: 徵收權、徵收程序與反向徵收
sentences.en: When municipal transit construction severely obstructs physical access or entirely deprives a commercial business of its customer parking facilities without the municipality initiating formal condemnation proceedings, the aggrieved landowner may file an action in inverse condemnation to compel the government to pay just compensation for the constructive taking of the entire property.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 inverse condemnation、compel the government to pay just compensation、constructive taking 等訴訟用語。)
sentences.hintZh: 當政府公共工程實質侵害、佔用或毀損私人房產價值（如拓寬大道佔用商場全部停車場導致其無法營業），卻未主動提起徵收及給予合理賠償時，由私有地主主動向法院起訴政府要求徵收補償的訴訟。

sentences.title: 一、AGENCY & REALTOR DEFINITIONS（代理總論與房地產經紀人定義）
sentences.titleZh: 代理總論與房地產經紀人定義
sentences.en: Under the common law of agency governing real estate transactions, a licensed broker acting on behalf of a principal owes absolute fiduciary duties exclusively to that client, while concurrently maintaining a statutory obligation to deal honestly, fairly, and in good faith with all unrepresented third parties involved in the negotiation.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 common law of agency、fiduciary duties exclusively to that client、unrepresented third parties、good faith 等考題對比用語。)
sentences.hintZh: 「Realtor」為特定行業商標，專指加入全國房地產經紀人協會（或地方經紀人公會）的持牌會員；非會員依法不得自稱為 Realtor。

sentences.title: 二、BASICS OF THE RELATIONSHIP & ACOLD（代理關係基礎與受託人義務）
sentences.titleZh: 代理關係基礎與受託人義務
sentences.en: Under the strict fiduciary duty of undivided loyalty codified within the ACOLD framework, an agent representing a motivated seller is legally prohibited from disclosing to prospective buyers that the seller is undergoing a contentious divorce or facing imminent foreclosure, as revealing such confidential details would materially undermine the principal's negotiating leverage.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 undivided loyalty、codified within、contentious divorce、undermine the principal's negotiating leverage 等經典情境題幹。)
sentences.hintZh: 代理關係會建立一種基於信任與信賴的受託人信託關係（Fiduciary Relationship），委託人依法須為代理人授權範圍內之行為承擔法律責任。

sentences.title: 三、DUAL AGENCY（雙重代理）
sentences.titleZh: 雙重代理
sentences.en: Because individual salespersons operate as subagents under their sponsoring brokerage firm, a dual agency legally materializes whenever two associated agents licensed under the same principal broker represent opposite sides of the identical real estate transaction, necessitating timely written disclosure and informed dual consent from both parties.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 subagents under their sponsoring brokerage firm、legally materializes、necessitating timely written disclosure、informed dual consent 等代理關係描述。)
sentences.hintZh: 指同一個房地產經紀機構（Broker）在同一筆交易中同時代表買方與賣方。

sentences.title: 四、UNIVERSAL, GENERAL, AND SPECIAL AGENTS（代理人三種權限類型）
sentences.titleZh: 代理人三種權限類型
sentences.en: While a property manager functions as a general agent vested with ongoing operational authority to bind the landlord across routine property maintenance matters, a listing broker acts solely as a special agent with strictly limited authorization to market the real estate and procure prospective buyers without the legal capacity to execute the final sales contract on the owner's behalf.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 general agent vs. special agent、vested with ongoing operational authority、procure prospective buyers、legal capacity to execute 等對比邏輯。)

sentences.title: 五、PRINCIPAL, CLIENT, CUSTOMER & ATTORNEY-IN-FACT（委託人、客戶、顧客與授權簽字人）
sentences.titleZh: 委託人、客戶、顧客與授權簽字人
sentences.en: Notwithstanding the conventional industry practice wherein the seller provides the transactional commission funds distributed through the Multiple Listing Service, the selling broker who has executed a buyer representation agreement maintains an uncompromised fiduciary duty exclusively to the buyer-client throughout all contract negotiations.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 transactional commission funds、cooperative splitting、maintains an uncompromised fiduciary duty 等買方代理常考觀念。)

sentences.title: 六、TYPES OF FRAUD & MISREPRESENTATION（各類詐欺與不實陳述）
sentences.titleZh: 各類詐欺與不實陳述
sentences.en: While actual fraud requires a deliberate intent to deceive through conscious affirmative falsehoods, constructive fraud arises when a licensee carelessly makes an inaccurate representation of a material fact without a reasonable factual basis, thereby inducing detrimental reliance by the buyer and subjecting the licensee to civil liabilities regardless of malicious intent.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 conscious affirmative falsehoods、constructive fraud、detrimental reliance（受損之信賴）、subjecting to civil liabilities 等法律名詞。)

sentences.title: 七、NEGLIGENCE & PUFFING（過失責任與誇大吹捧）
sentences.titleZh: 過失責任與誇大吹捧
sentences.en: In real estate marketing, mere puffing—characterized by subjective superlatives and non-factual sales rhetoric regarding property ambiance—is legally permissible, but once a licensee makes an unsupported factual assertion regarding objective zoning classifications or boundary lines, such conduct crosses the boundary into actionable negligence or misrepresentation.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 mere puffing、subjective superlatives、unsupported factual assertion、actionable negligence 等考題判定界線。)

sentences.title: 八、STIGMATIZED PROPERTY（瑕疵心理性物業 / 凶宅與污名化房產）
sentences.titleZh: 瑕疵心理性物業 / 凶宅與污名化房產
sentences.en: A stigmatized property is legally defined as real estate that suffers a reduction in marketability due to psychological or emotional factors unrelated to physical defects—such as a tragic homicide or widely publicized suicide occurring on site—imposing specific statutory disclosure duties upon the seller depending on state-specific real property disclosure statutes.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 psychological or emotional factors unrelated to physical defects、tragic homicide、statutory disclosure duties 等凶宅定義與揭露用語。)
sentences.hintZh: 因過往發生的特定心理性、歷史性或非物理性事件而導致買方產生抗拒感的房產（例如曾發生謀殺、自殺、鬧鬼傳聞或重大刑案，但房屋實體結構本身並無損壞）。

sentences.title: 一、CONTRACT BASICS & GENERAL CLAUSES（合約基礎與常見條款）
sentences.titleZh: 合約基礎與常見條款
sentences.en: Although an 'as is' provision in a residential purchase agreement explicitly relieves the seller from the financial responsibility of repairing discovered physical defects, it does not exempt them from statutory disclosures, and if the contract contains a strict 'time is of the essence' clause, the failure of either party to meet designated closing deadlines constitutes a material breach entitling the non-defaulting party to seek rescission or sue for specific performance.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 'as is' provision、statutory disclosures、material breach、seek rescission or sue for specific performance 等綜合考點。)
sentences.hintZh: 合約是承諾作為或不作為特定事項的口頭或書面協議。依據反詐欺法（Statute of Frauds），絕大多數不動產契約（如買賣合約、契據、抵押設定等）必須具備書面形式始具法律強制執行力。

sentences.title: 二、FOUR ESSENTIAL ELEMENTS OF A VALID CONTRACT（有效合約四大成立要件）
sentences.titleEn: 二、FOUR ESSENTIAL ELEMENTS OF A VALID CONTRACT
sentences.titleZh: 有效合約四大成立要件
sentences.en: A legally enforceable real estate sales contract fundamentally requires capable parties possessing legal capacity, a lawful objective, sufficient bargained-for consideration, and mutual assent evidenced by an unequivocal offer and acceptance; hence, any unaccepted counteroffer proposed by the seller immediately acts as a legal rejection that permanently terminates the buyer's original offer.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 capable parties、lawful objective、mutual assent、unequivocal offer and acceptance、permanently terminates 等要件詞彙。)
sentences.hintZh: 有效合約必須同時具備四大要件：

sentences.title: 三、CONTRACT VALIDITY: VALID, VOID, AND VOIDABLE（有效、無效與得撤銷合約）
sentences.titleEn: 三、CONTRACT VALIDITY: VALID, VOID, AND VOIDABLE
sentences.titleZh: 有效、無效與得撤銷合約
sentences.en: While a contract executed for an unlawful purpose or executed by a person legally declared mentally incompetent is completely void ab initio with zero legal standing, a real estate purchase agreement signed under duress or induced by material misrepresentation is merely voidable at the sole discretion of the aggrieved party.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：區分 void ab initio（自始無效）與 voidable at the sole discretion of the aggrieved party（受害方得自由決定是否撤銷）。)

sentences.title: 四、EXECUTED VS. EXECUTORY & BILATERAL VS. UNILATERAL CONTRACTS（履約狀態與契約形式）
sentences.titleEn: 四、EXECUTED VS. EXECUTORY & BILATERAL VS. UNILATERAL CONTRACTS
sentences.titleZh: 履約狀態與契約形式
sentences.en: A standard purchase agreement during the pending escrow period is classified as an executory, bilateral contract because mutual promises remain outstanding between buyer and seller, whereas an unexercised option contract represents a unilateral agreement where only the optionor is legally bound to perform until the optionee formally exercises their right to buy.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 executory, bilateral contract 與 unilateral agreement 之精準法律分類。)

sentences.title: 五、SPECIFIC TYPES OF CONTRACTS: LAND CONTRACT, OPTION, AND IMPLIED（特定合約類型）
sentences.titleEn: 五、SPECIFIC TYPES OF CONTRACTS: LAND CONTRACT, OPTION, AND IMPLIED
sentences.titleZh: 特定合約類型
sentences.en: Under an installment land contract, the vendor retains bare legal title as security for the debt while conveying equitable title and possession to the vendee, thereby conferring upon the buyer a beneficial ownership interest and the irrevocable legal right to demand a formal deed upon satisfaction of the final purchase payment.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 bare legal title、equitable title、beneficial ownership interest、upon satisfaction of final payment 等土地契約專業用語。)

sentences.title: 六、LISTINGS & THE MULTIPLE LISTING SERVICE（委託銷售合約與 MLS 系統）
sentences.titleZh: 委託銷售合約與 MLS 系統
sentences.en: Because a listing agreement constitutes a non-assignable personal service contract between a seller and a principal broker, the agreement automatically terminates upon the death of either party, property destruction, or a material change in zoning, but a properly drafted protection period clause preserves the broker's right to compensation if a procured buyer purchases the property shortly after expiration.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 non-assignable personal service contract、material change in zoning、protection period clause 等考題判定要點。)

sentences.title: 4. Net Listing（淨額委託銷售）
sentences.en: The fundamental legal distinction among residential listing agreements centers on commission entitlement: under an exclusive right to sell listing, the broker earns compensation regardless of whether the buyer was procured by the agent or the owner, whereas under an exclusive agency listing, the seller retains the express contractual right to procure a buyer independently without incurring any commission liability.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 exclusive right to sell vs. exclusive agency、regardless of who procured the buyer、incurring commission liability 等對比句構。)
sentences.hintZh: 屋主設定一個實收底價（Net Amount），成交價超出該底價之所有超額利潤全數作為經紀人之佣金。因易引發嚴重的利益衝突與道德風險，在許多州被明令禁止或受嚴格管制。

sentences.title: 八、EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT（履約保證金 / 誠意訂金）
sentences.titleZh: 履約保證金 / 誠意訂金
sentences.en: Although an earnest money deposit is not a mandatory legal element required to validate an executory sales contract, it serves as tangible evidence of the buyer's good-faith intention to perform, and under standard liquidated damages provisions, it may be rightfully forfeited to the seller if the buyer unexcusedly defaults after all financing contingencies have been satisfied.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 tangible evidence of good-faith intention、liquidated damages provisions、rightfully forfeited、unexcusedly defaults 等履約保證金考點。)
sentences.hintZh: 買方於提出買賣要約時一併給付之善意保證金，用以表明履約之誠意（性質如同求婚時的訂婚戒指）。

sentences.title: 一、DEPRECIATION & ITS CLASSIFICATIONS（折舊概念與可修復性分類）
sentences.titleZh: 折舊概念與可修復性分類
sentences.en: When evaluating property deterioration for appraisal purposes, physical defects are deemed economically curable only if the total expenditure required to remedy the condition contributes an equal or greater dollar increase to the overall market value of the real estate, whereas defects that cost significantly more to repair than the value they recover are classified as incurable.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 deemed economically curable、expenditure required to remedy、contributes an equal or greater dollar increase、classified as incurable 等條件對比句構。)
sentences.hintZh: 折舊指不動產因任何原因隨時間推移而產生的任何價值減損。

sentences.title: 3. Physical Deterioration（實體折舊 / 自然耗損）
sentences.titleEn: 3. Physical Deterioration（實體折舊 / 自然耗損）
sentences.en: While functional obsolescence stems from intrinsic design deficiencies or outdated layouts within the property boundaries—such as an inadequate single-car garage serving a large executive residence—economic obsolescence is triggered exclusively by adverse external forces beyond the owner's control, rendering it virtually incurable under standard appraisal methodologies.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 intrinsic design deficiencies within boundaries 與 adverse external forces beyond control 的本質差異。)
sentences.hintZh: 因日常使用磨損、自然老化、欠缺常規維護或風吹雨淋等自然外力所造成的肉眼可見實體減損。

sentences.title: 三、EFFECTIVE AGE VS. ECONOMIC LIFE（有效年齡 vs. 經濟壽命）
sentences.titleZh: 有效年齡 vs. 經濟壽命
sentences.en: An appraiser assessing a well-maintained commercial building will frequently assign an effective age substantially younger than its true chronological age to reflect ongoing capital improvements, while recognizing that the asset's total economic life—the timeframe during which it remains profitably viable—will inevitably expire before its physical structure collapses.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 assign an effective age substantially younger than its true chronological age、profitably viable 等表達。)
sentences.hintZh: 依據物業的外觀維護狀況與實體品質所推定的年齡，而非建物建造至今的實際曆法年齡（Chronological age）。

sentences.title: 四、DETERMINING VALUE & ELEMENTS OF VALUE（價值認定流程與價值四大要素）
sentences.titleZh: 價值認定流程與價值四大要素
sentences.en: Although an appraiser relies on the four essential elements of value encapsulated in the acronym STUD—scarcity, transferability, utility, and demand—to formulate an objective opinion of market value, that derived value frequently diverges from both the historical construction cost and the ultimate market price negotiated between buyer and seller.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 encapsulated in the acronym STUD、objective opinion of market value、diverges from historical construction cost 等句式。)

sentences.title: 五、ASSEMBLAGE AND PLOTTAGE（土地合併與合併增值）
sentences.titleZh: 土地合併與合併增值
sentences.en: When a commercial developer acquires three contiguous downtown lots through the procedural process of assemblage, the combined consolidated tract frequently achieves a substantial increase in total utility and market worth known as plottage value, which exceeds the aggregate individual values of the separate parcels.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：區分 assemblage（行為/過程）與 plottage value（增值結果）之概念。)
sentences.hintZh: 將兩筆或多筆相鄰地塊合併為一筆較大地塊的實體或法律「整合行為/程序」。

sentences.title: 六、GROSS RENT MULTIPLIER - GRM（總租金乘數法）
sentences.titleZh: 總租金乘數法
sentences.en: Because the gross rent multiplier evaluates residential income properties by comparing the total sales price against raw gross rental receipts prior to accounting for real estate taxes, insurance, or vacancies, investors utilize a low GRM as an initial screening benchmark to identify properties with rapid gross capital recovery potential.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 raw gross rental receipts prior to accounting for operating expenses、rapid gross capital recovery potential 等指標含義。)
sentences.hintZh: 物業售價與其尚未扣除營運費用前之「總租金收入（毛租金）」之間的比率指標。

sentences.title: 七、COST APPROACH / REPLACEMENT APPROACH（成本法 / 重置成本法）
sentences.titleZh: 成本法 / 重置成本法
sentences.en: The cost replacement approach is universally regarded as the most reliable appraisal methodology for newly constructed buildings and special-purpose institutional properties like public schools and libraries, effectively setting the upper ceiling of market value by calculating the current reproduction cost of improvements, deducting accrued depreciation, and adding the raw site value.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 special-purpose institutional properties、setting the upper ceiling of market value、current reproduction cost、deducting accrued depreciation 等核心要點。)
sentences.hintZh: 依據當前重新建造或重置地上改良物的成本，扣除累積折舊後，再加上土地估計市價得出總價值的估價方法。

sentences.title: 八、CAPITALIZATION APPROACH / INCOME APPROACH（收益資本化法 / 收益法）
sentences.titleZh: 收益資本化法 / 收益法
sentences.en: Under the income capitalization approach commonly utilized for retail shopping centers, an appraiser establishes property value by dividing net operating income by an appropriate capitalization rate, wherein higher-risk commercial properties mandate higher capitalization rates that proportionally depress the resulting capital valuation.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 net operating income、appropriate capitalization rate、higher-risk commercial properties mandate higher capitalization rates 等收益法考點。)
sentences.hintZh: 主要用於商業及收益性不動產（如購物中心、辦公大樓），依據未來預期收益將物業的「淨營運收入（NOI）」直接資本化轉換為現行資產市值的估價方法。

sentences.title: 九、MARKET DATA APPROACH / SALES COMPARISON APPROACH（市場比較法 / 銷售比較法）
sentences.titleEn: 九、MARKET DATA APPROACH / SALES COMPARISON APPROACH
sentences.titleZh: 市場比較法 / 銷售比較法
sentences.en: The market data approach, which serves as the primary valuation standard for single-family residences based on the principle of substitution, requires the appraiser to identify arm's-length comparable sales from the past six months and perform dollar adjustments strictly to the comparable properties to account for variances in location, physical condition, and site amenities.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 arm's-length comparable sales、perform dollar adjustments strictly to the comparable properties、principle of substitution 等住宅估價經典句型。)
sentences.hintZh: 透過將評估標的物與同區域內近期成交、規格條件相近之相似物業（可比物業/Comps）進行比對調整以決定價值的估價方法。

sentences.title: 一、PROGRESSION AND REGRESSION（漸進原則與漸退原則）
sentences.titleZh: 漸進原則與漸退原則
sentences.en: Under the valuation principles of progression and regression, an appraiser recognizes that an over-improved luxury residence situated within a modest, low-density subdivision will inevitably suffer a downward valuation adjustment due to the regressive pull of the surrounding neighborhood, whereas an inferior property located among prestigious estates will enjoy an unearned increment in market value through progression.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 over-improved luxury residence、inevitably suffer a downward valuation adjustment、regressive pull、unearned increment through progression 等名詞搭配。)
sentences.hintZh: 描述周遭鄰里環境與相鄰房產如何拉抬或拖累特定物業價值的基本估價原則。

sentences.title: 二、PRINCIPLE OF CONTRIBUTION（貢獻原則）
sentences.titleZh: 貢獻原則
sentences.en: In accordance with the principle of contribution, an appraiser does not calculate the value of an added luxury amenity based on the contractor's historical construction invoices, but rather measures the objective marginal value that the improvement actually contributes to the overall marketability and ultimate selling price of the real estate.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 historical construction invoices、objective marginal value、actually contributes to the overall marketability 等貢獻原則的核心辨析。)
sentences.hintZh: 又稱邊際貢獻原則，指任何加建或改良物（如泳池、加蓋房間）的真正價值，取決於它能為整個房產的市場總值「貢獻（增加）」多少金額，而非建造該設施所實際花費的施工成本。

sentences.title: 三、PRINCIPLE OF CONFORMITY（一致性原則 / 協調原則）
sentences.titleZh: 一致性原則 / 協調原則
sentences.en: The principle of conformity dictates that residential property values achieve optimal stability when neighborhood improvements harmonize in design, density, and price range, while in commercial real estate, conformity ensures that complementary retail tenants clustered within a development attract a synergistic consumer demographic.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 achieve optimal stability、harmonize in design, density, and price range、synergistic consumer demographic 等考點用語。)
sentences.hintZh: 估價原則指出：當社區內的建物在建築風格、土地用途、規模大小及周邊環境規劃上維持協調一致（Conformity）時，物業價值與社區經濟穩定度能達到最大化。

sentences.title: 四、PRINCIPLE OF SUBSTITUTION（替代原則）
sentences.titleZh: 替代原則
sentences.en: Serving as the foundational cornerstone for the sales comparison appraisal approach, the principle of substitution affirms that a prudent and rational buyer will pay no more for a subject property than the financial expenditure required to purchase an equally desirable alternative asset with comparable utility and physical characteristics in the open market.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 foundational cornerstone、prudent and rational buyer、financial expenditure required、comparable utility 等題幹慣用語。)
sentences.hintZh: 市場比較法（銷售比較法）的核心理論基石。該原則指出：一筆物業的最高合理市場價值，不會超過在市場上購買另一筆具有相同效用、格局與收益潛力的替代物業所需之花費（理性買方不會為相同效用的物業支付過高價格）。

sentences.title: 五、PRINCIPLE OF HIGHEST AND BEST USE（最高最佳使用原則）
sentences.titleEn: 五、PRINCIPLE OF HIGHEST AND BEST USE
sentences.titleZh: 最高最佳使用原則
sentences.en: To determine the highest and best use of a prime vacant parcel, an appraiser must systematically filter prospective development concepts through four sequential tests to verify that the proposed project is legally permitted under zoning, physically feasible given site topography, economically viable in light of market absorption rates, and capable of generating the maximum net operating return to the investor.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 systematically filter through four sequential tests、market absorption rates、maximum net operating return 等鑑定用語。)
sentences.hintZh: 無論當前現況用途為何，透過基地分析所推估出能為土地或物業創造最高現值淨回報與最大經濟效益的合理且合法的用途。過渡時期的短期用途稱為「過渡用途（Interim Use）」。

sentences.title: 六、FINANCING BASICS: ASSUME VS. SUBJECT TO & LOAN SERVICING（融資基礎：承擔貸款 vs. 附帶貸款條件與貸款服務）
sentences.titleEn: 六、FINANCING BASICS: ASSUME VS. SUBJECT TO & LOAN SERVICING
sentences.titleZh: 融資基礎：承擔貸款 vs. 附帶貸款條件與貸款服務
sentences.en: When a grantee acquires residential real estate 'subject to' an existing mortgage, the purchaser takes legal title and agrees to make scheduled payments without assuming personal liability, leaving the original mortgagor primarily responsible to the lender in the event of default, whereas a formal loan assumption shifts primary contractual liability directly onto the incoming buyer upon written lender qualification.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 acquires real estate 'subject to'、takes legal title without assuming personal liability、shifts primary contractual liability onto incoming buyer 等對比邏輯。)
sentences.hintZh: 買方書面承諾承擔既有貸款之直接還款法律責任。買方負主要責任，賣方轉為次要責任（除非銀行簽署 Novation 免除賣方責任）。必須經過銀行審核買方信用並簽署承擔協議。

sentences.title: 七、ADVANTAGES & DISADVANTAGES OF REAL ESTATE INVESTING（房地產投資之優劣勢）
sentences.titleEn: 七、ADVANTAGES & DISADVANTAGES OF REAL ESTATE INVESTING
sentences.titleZh: 房地產投資之優劣勢
sentences.en: Although real estate investments provide compelling financial benefits such as cash flow generation, long-term equity accumulation, and the use of financial leverage to maximize return on invested capital, they concurrently present substantial disadvantages including extreme illiquidity, ongoing market risk, and the necessity of specialized transactional knowledge.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 compelling financial benefits、equity accumulation、financial leverage、extreme illiquidity 等投資評估核心詞彙。)

sentences.title: 八、INVESTING TERMS & CO-OWNERSHIP STRUCTURES（投資專用術語與組織型態）
sentences.titleZh: 投資專用術語與組織型態
sentences.en: To qualify for tax pass-through status and eliminate corporate-level double taxation under federal guidelines, a Real Estate Investment Trust must comprise a minimum of one hundred individual investors, maintain no less than seventy-five percent of its underlying asset base in real estate holdings, and distribute at least ninety-five percent of its net annual operating income directly to certificate beneficiaries.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 tax pass-through status、corporate-level double taxation、comprise a minimum of one hundred investors、distribute at least ninety-five percent 等 REITs 核心稅法考點。)
sentences.hintZh: 集合至少 100 名投資人資金，由受託人集中管理大型不動產之信託架構。若將 75% 以上資產投資於房地產，並將每年 95% 以上之收益配發給投資人，信託本身可免繳公司所得稅（避免雙重課稅），其持份憑證可自由轉讓交易。

sentences.title: 1. Acceleration Clause & Alienation Clause（加速到期條款與讓與/轉讓條款）
sentences.titleZh: 加速到期條款與讓與/轉讓條款
sentences.en: While an acceleration clause is triggered primarily by the borrower's default on scheduled mortgage payments to declare the full unpaid balance immediately due, an alienation or due-on-sale clause is invoked upon any voluntary conveyance or transfer of title, effectively barring the mortgagor from assigning the underlying loan without the express qualification and consent of the mortgagee.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 triggered by default vs. invoked upon voluntary conveyance、declaring unpaid balance immediately due 等辨析詞組。)

sentences.title: 2. Prepayment Clause, Lock-In Clause & Subordination Clause（提前還款、鎖定與順位次級條款）
sentences.titleEn: 2. Prepayment Clause, Lock-In Clause & Subordination Clause
sentences.titleZh: 提前還款、鎖定與順位次級條款
sentences.en: Under a subordination clause commonly utilized in vacant land development financing, an existing seller-held purchase money mortgage agrees to yield priority to a subsequent institutional construction loan, thereby placing the initial lien in a junior, subordinate position.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 yield priority to、subsequent construction loan、junior/subordinate position 等土地融資常用語。)

sentences.title: 二、TRUTH IN LENDING ACT & APR（誠信貸款法與年百分率）
sentences.titleZh: 誠信貸款法與年百分率
sentences.en: Under the consumer protection mandates of the Truth in Lending Act, lenders are legally required to disclose the comprehensive Annual Percentage Rate, which reflects the true cost of credit by combining the nominal interest rate with upfront finance charges and origination points, while extending a mandatory three-business-day right of rescission for refinanced principal residences.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 standardized expression of total credit cost、nominal rate combined with upfront fees、three-business-day right of rescission 等法定揭露概念。)

sentences.title: 1. Amortized, Balloon, and Buy Down Loans（攤還、氣球貸與降息點數）
sentences.titleEn: 1. Amortized, Balloon, and Buy Down Loans
sentences.titleZh: 攤還、氣球貸與降息點數
sentences.en: Unlike a fully amortized mortgage where scheduled monthly installments steadily reduce both principal and interest to zero at the conclusion of the term, a balloon loan requires a substantial final lump-sum payment because regular amortization schedules fail to liquidate the underlying debt prior to maturity.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 scheduled monthly installments steadily reduce principal to zero、substantial final lump-sum payment 等結構對比。)

sentences.title: 2. Equity, HELOC, and Adjustable Rate Mortgages（房屋淨值、淨值信貸額度與浮動利率房貸）
sentences.titleEn: 2. Equity, HELOC, and Adjustable Rate Mortgages
sentences.titleZh: 房屋淨值、淨值信貸額度與浮動利率房貸
sentences.en: An adjustable rate mortgage ties the borrower's ongoing borrowing costs directly to a fluctuating financial market index plus a constant lender margin, utilizing periodic and lifetime rate caps to protect consumers against extreme payment shocks during volatile economic cycles.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 fluctuating financial market index、constant lender margin、periodic and lifetime rate caps 等 ARM 機制專用詞。)

sentences.title: 3. Blanket, Growing Equity, and Graduated Payment Mortgages（總括抵押、成長淨值貸與漸進式房貸）
sentences.titleEn: 3. Blanket, Growing Equity, and Graduated Payment Mortgages
sentences.titleZh: 總括抵押、成長淨值貸與漸進式房貸
sentences.en: While a growing equity mortgage applies planned payment increases directly toward principal amortization to accelerate final payoff, a graduated payment mortgage often triggers negative amortization during its introductory years because artificially low initial payments fail to cover accrued interest charges.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：區分 growing equity mortgage（本金加速）與 graduated payment mortgage（初期負攤還風險）。)

sentences.title: 4. Open-End, Construction, Package, and Participation Loans（開放式、建築短貸、組合包與參與貸款）
sentences.titleEn: 4. Open-End, Construction, Package, and Participation Loans
sentences.titleZh: 開放式、建築短貸、組合包與參與貸款
sentences.en: A real estate developer securing interim financing relies on a short-term construction loan disbursed through progress payments across verified building phases, which must ultimately be liquidated upon project completion through a permanent take-out mortgage commitment.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 interim financing、disbursed through progress payments、take-out mortgage commitment 等建築融資流程名詞。)

sentences.title: 5. Purchase Money, Reverse, Straight, Wraparound, and Sale-Leaseback（賣方融資、反向抵押、純利息、包裹貸款與售後回租）
sentences.titleEn: 5. Purchase Money, Reverse, Straight, Wraparound, and Sale-Leaseback
sentences.titleZh: 賣方融資、反向抵押、純利息、包裹貸款與售後回租
sentences.en: Under a commercial sale-leaseback transaction, a business owner monetizes real estate equity to fund enterprise operations while retaining uninterrupted physical occupancy, thereby transforming capital expenditures into fully deductible rent expenses while providing the investor with a long-term passive return.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 monetizes real estate equity、retaining uninterrupted physical occupancy、fully deductible rent expenses 等售後回租題幹核心。)

sentences.title: 1. Primary Mortgage Market Entities（一級房貸市場放款機構）
sentences.titleZh: 一級房貸市場放款機構
sentences.en: While a licensed mortgage broker operates strictly as a transactional intermediary matching prospective borrowers with third-party institutional lenders for a loan origination fee, a mortgage banker functions as a direct lender originating, underwriting, and funding mortgages in its own name.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 transactional intermediary、loan origination fee、direct lender originating and funding 等對比關鍵詞。)

sentences.title: 2. Secondary Mortgage Market & Historical Evolution（二級房貸市場與歷史演進）
sentences.titleZh: 二級房貸市場與歷史演進
sentences.en: By purchasing blocks of government-insured and conventional mortgages directly from primary lenders and securitizing them for Wall Street investors, secondary mortgage entities like Fannie Mae and Ginnie Mae inject vital liquidity into the domestic banking system, ensuring local originators possess continuous capital to underwrite new consumer home loans.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 purchasing blocks of mortgages、securitizing them for investors、inject vital liquidity into banking system 等二級市場運作表達。)

sentences.title: 1. Federal Housing Administration - FHA Loans（聯邦住房管理局保險貸款）
sentences.titleZh: 聯邦住房管理局保險貸款
sentences.en: Because the Federal Housing Administration operates strictly as an insurer rather than a direct mortgage originator, it protects qualified lending institutions against default losses on high-LTV residential loans, mandating that borrowers pay upfront and ongoing mortgage insurance premiums while prohibiting prepayment penalties and non-qualifying debt assumptions.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 operates as an insurer rather than a direct originator、high-LTV residential loans、ongoing mortgage insurance premiums 等 FHA 核心定義。)
sentences.hintZh: FHA 本身不直接發放貸款；其核心職能是為核准銀行的放款提供保險，若借款人違約斷供，由 FHA 賠付銀行之損失。

sentences.title: 2. Veterans Affairs - VA Guaranteed Loans（退伍軍人事務部保證貸款）
sentences.titleZh: 退伍軍人事務部保證貸款
sentences.en: Under the VA home loan guaranty program designed to assist qualified military veterans, approved lenders can extend hundred-percent financing without requiring any down payment or monthly private mortgage insurance premiums, backed by a federal guaranty that reimburses lender losses in the event of foreclosure.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 hundred-percent financing without down payment、no monthly private mortgage insurance premiums、backed by a federal guaranty 等 VA 考點。)
sentences.hintZh: 創設於 1944 年，旨在協助退伍軍人置產；透過由聯邦政府向核准銀行提供貸款保證（Guaranty），使符合資格的軍人得以享受零頭期款購屋。

sentences.title: 1. Trust Deeds Mechanics（信託契據法律架構）
sentences.titleZh: 信託契據法律架構
sentences.en: Under a deed of trust securing real estate financing, the trustor conveys bare legal title with the power of sale to a neutral trustee while retaining equitable title and possession, meaning that upon full loan payoff, the trustee must execute a formal deed of reconveyance to extinguish the underlying encumbrance.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 trustor conveys bare legal title with power of sale、retaining equitable title、deed of reconveyance 等信託契據架構用語。)

sentences.title: 2. Mortgages & Judicial Foreclosure（抵押權、借據與司法拍賣）
sentences.titleZh: 抵押權、借據與司法拍賣
sentences.en: In jurisdictions adhering strictly to lien theory principles of real estate finance, the mortgagor maintains legal and equitable ownership while granting the mortgagee a voluntary lien, requiring the lender to initiate a formal judicial foreclosure action through the courts should a default occur under the promissory note.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 lien theory principles、mortgagor maintains legal title、granting mortgagee a voluntary lien、formal judicial foreclosure 等抵押法理結構。)

sentences.title: 一、FEDERAL FAIR HOUSING ACT & PROTECTED CLASSES（聯邦公平住房法與受保護群體）
sentences.titleEn: 一、FEDERAL FAIR HOUSING ACT & PROTECTED CLASSES
sentences.titleZh: 聯邦公平住房法與受保護群體
sentences.en: Affirmed by the landmark Supreme Court ruling in Jones v. Mayer under the constitutional authority of the Thirteenth Amendment, the federal Fair Housing Act as administered by HUD strictly prohibits housing discrimination across seven protected classes—originally banning racial, religious, and national origin prejudice before subsequent congressional amendments incorporated sex, physical or mental disability, and familial status.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 constitutional authority of the Thirteenth Amendment、administered by HUD、prohibits discrimination across seven protected classes、familial status 等聯邦法規考點。)
sentences.hintZh: 於 1968 年 4 月 11 日馬丁·路德·金恩遇刺後一週由國會火速通過，旨在全面禁止在住宅買賣、租賃及房貸融資過程中的歧視行為。

sentences.title: 二、THE AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT OF 1990（1990 年美國身心障礙法案）
sentences.titleEn: 二、THE AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT OF 1990
sentences.titleZh: 1990 年美國身心障礙法案
sentences.en: Under the statutory mandates of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, property management offices and commercial facilities open to the public must remove physical barriers and provide reasonable structural accommodations to ensure that persons with physical or mental impairments enjoy equal, unhindered access to real estate services.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：注意 statutory mandates、commercial facilities open to the public、remove physical barriers、reasonable structural accommodations 等 ADA 核心概念。)
sentences.hintZh: 廣泛的民事權利法案，明令禁止在公共場所、就業、大眾交通工具及商業物業環境中對身心障礙人士產生歧視。

sentences.title: 3. Redlining（紅線圈管 / 區域金融歧視）
sentences.titleEn: 3. Redlining（紅線圈管 / 區域金融歧視）
sentences.en: While blockbusting involves unlawfully soliciting listings by fabricating neighborhood demographic panic among existing homeowners, steering limits buyer choices by channeling prospective purchasers into segregated neighborhoods based on protected classes, which functionally aligns with redlining wherein financial institutions systematically deny mortgage credit across minority-dominated zip codes regardless of borrower creditworthiness.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：區分 blockbusting（向屋主製造恐慌收 listing）、steering（帶買方看房時限縮區域）、redlining（銀行直接在特定地圖區域拒貸）三大考點。)
sentences.hintZh: 銀行或保險機構僅因某特定地理區域（早期在地圖上以紅筆畫圈標示）屬於少數族裔集中區，便直接拒絕放貸、調高利息保費或拒保，而完全不考量個別申請人本身的良好信用與資力。

sentences.title: 四、SHERMAN ANTI-TRUST ACT & UNLAWFUL TRADE PRACTICES（謝爾曼反托拉斯法與違法限制競爭）
sentences.titleEn: 四、SHERMAN ANTI-TRUST ACT & UNLAWFUL TRADE PRACTICES
sentences.titleZh: 謝爾曼反托拉斯法與違法限制競爭
sentences.en: Under the strict provisions of the Sherman Anti-Trust Act, competing brokerage firms are explicitly barred from engaging in price-fixing conspiracies or allocating geographical sales territories, and any broker who unlawfully conditions a parcel sale upon a mandatory tie-in listing contract exposes the brokerage to federal criminal prosecution as well as civil lawsuits awarding treble damages plus attorney fees to the aggrieved party.
sentences.examFocus: (解析重點：掌握 engaging in price-fixing conspiracies、allocating geographical sales territories、mandatory tie-in listing contract、awarding treble damages 等反壟斷法核心重點。)
sentences.hintZh: 聯邦反托拉斯法，旨在維持自由競爭的市場環境，全面禁止房地產經紀行業中任何限制商業競爭、聯合壟斷或操縱市場之行為。
